        document.getElementById('frozen-p2').style.display = 'none';

        let q = activeDuelCtx.questionsPool[activeDuelCtx.currentQIdx];
        const qIdxDisplay = activeDuelCtx.currentQIdx + 1;
        document.getElementById('duel-q-idx-p1').innerText = qIdxDisplay;
        document.getElementById('duel-q-total-p1').innerText = activeDuelCtx.questionCount;
        document.getElementById('duel-q-idx-p2').innerText = qIdxDisplay;
        document.getElementById('duel-q-total-p2').innerText = activeDuelCtx.questionCount;

        document.getElementById('p1-hint').innerText = q.hint;
        document.getElementById('p1-target').innerText = q.target;
        document.getElementById('p2-hint').innerText = q.hint;
        document.getElementById('p2-target').innerText = q.target;

        renderDuelOptions('p1', q);
        renderDuelOptions('p2', q);
    }

    function renderDuelOptions(side, q) {
        const container = document.getElementById(`${side}-options`);
        container.innerHTML = '';
        let opts = [...q.options].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
        opts.forEach(opt => {
            const btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.className = 'option-btn';
            btn.style.fontSize = '18px';
            btn.style.padding = '10px 18px';
            btn.style.touchAction = 'manipulation';
            btn.style.userSelect = 'none';
            btn.innerText = opt;
            let tapped = false;
            const onTap = (e) => {
                if (e && e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
                if (tapped) return;
                tapped = true;
                setTimeout(() => { tapped = false; }, 350);
                handleDuelAnswer(side, opt, q.correctAnswer, btn);
            };
            btn.addEventListener('pointerup', onTap);
            btn.addEventListener('click', onTap);
            container.appendChild(btn);
        });
    }

    function handleDuelAnswer(side, chosen, correct, btnEl) {
        if (!activeDuelCtx || activeDuelCtx.roundResolved) return;
        if (side === 'p1' && activeDuelCtx.p1Frozen) return;
        if (side === 'p2' && activeDuelCtx.p2Frozen) return;

        const q = activeDuelCtx.questionsPool[activeDuelCtx.currentQIdx];
        const playerObj = side === 'p1' ? activeDuelCtx.p1 : activeDuelCtx.p2;
        const isCorrect = (normalizeAnswerToken(chosen) === normalizeAnswerToken(correct));

        activeDuelCtx.duelLogs.push({
            questionNum: activeDuelCtx.currentQIdx + 1,
            gameType: q.gameType || 'sounds',
            target: q.target,
            hint: q.hint,
            playerSide: side,
            playerName: playerObj.name,
            chosen: chosen,
            correctAnswer: correct,
            correct: isCorrect,
            timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('he-IL', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' })
        });

        if (q.gameType === 'sequences') {
            const targetEl = document.getElementById(`${side}-target`);
            if (targetEl && targetEl.innerText.includes('__')) {
                const fillColor = isCorrect ? '#2a9d8f' : '#e63946';
                targetEl.innerHTML = targetEl.innerText.replace('__', `<span style="color: ${fillColor}; text-decoration: underline;">${chosen}</span>`);
            }
        }

        if (isCorrect) {
            activeDuelCtx.roundResolved = true;
            btnEl.classList.add('correct-highlight');
            playSuccessSound();
            try { confetti({ particleCount: 55, spread: 65, origin: { y: side === 'p1' ? 0.3 : 0.7 } }); } catch (e) {}

            if (side === 'p1') activeDuelCtx.p1Score += 1;
            else activeDuelCtx.p2Score += 1;

            document.getElementById('p1-score-display').innerText = `⭐ ניקוד: ${activeDuelCtx.p1Score}`;
            document.getElementById('p2-score-display').innerText = `⭐ ניקוד: ${activeDuelCtx.p2Score}`;

            activeDuelCtx.currentQIdx++;
            let match = activeTournament.rounds[activeDuelCtx.roundIdx].matches[activeDuelCtx.matchIdx];
            match.currentQIdx = activeDuelCtx.currentQIdx;
            match.p1Score = activeDuelCtx.p1Score;
            match.p2Score = activeDuelCtx.p2Score;
            match.duelLogs = activeDuelCtx.duelLogs;
            saveToLocalStorage();

            setTimeout(() => {
                loadDuelQuestion();
            }, 900);
        } else {
            btnEl.classList.add('wrong-highlight');
            playErrorSound();
            if (side === 'p1') {
                activeDuelCtx.p1Frozen = true;
                document.getElementById('frozen-p1').style.display = 'flex';
                activeDuelCtx.p1FreezeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (activeDuelCtx && activeDuelCtx.p1Frozen) {
                        activeDuelCtx.p1Frozen = false;
                        document.getElementById('frozen-p1').style.display = 'none';
                    }
                }, 2500);
            } else {
                activeDuelCtx.p2Frozen = true;
                document.getElementById('frozen-p2').style.display = 'flex';
                activeDuelCtx.p2FreezeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (activeDuelCtx && activeDuelCtx.p2Frozen) {
                        activeDuelCtx.p2Frozen = false;
                        document.getElementById('frozen-p2').style.display = 'none';
                    }
                }, 2500);
            }
        }
    }

    function endDuelMatch() {
        const p1Score = activeDuelCtx.p1Score;
        const p2Score = activeDuelCtx.p2Score;
        const winner = p1Score > p2Score ? activeDuelCtx.p1 : activeDuelCtx.p2;

        const rIdx = activeDuelCtx.roundIdx;
        const mIdx = activeDuelCtx.matchIdx;
        let match = activeTournament.rounds[rIdx].matches[mIdx];
        match.status = 'completed';
        match.p1Score = p1Score;
        match.p2Score = p2Score;
        match.winner = winner;
        match.duelLogs = activeDuelCtx.duelLogs;
        match.completedAt = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('he-IL', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

        if (rIdx + 1 < activeTournament.rounds.length) {
            let nextMatchIdx = Math.floor(mIdx / 2);
            let nextMatch = activeTournament.rounds[rIdx + 1].matches[nextMatchIdx];
            if (mIdx % 2 === 0) nextMatch.p1 = winner;
            else nextMatch.p2 = winner;

            if (nextMatch.p1 && nextMatch.p2) {
                nextMatch.status = 'ready';
            }
        } else {
            activeTournament.status = 'completed';
            activeTournament.champion = winner;
            activeTournament.completedAt = new Date().toLocaleDateString('he-IL') + ' ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('he-IL', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
            tournamentHistory.unshift(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(activeTournament)));
        }

        const buildSnapshotForDuel = (player, scoreVal, logsArr) => {
            const pLogs = logsArr.filter(l => l.playerName === player.name).map(l => ({
                level: rIdx + 1,
                target: l.target,
                hint: l.hint,
                correctAnswer: l.correctAnswer,
                chosen: l.chosen,
                correct: l.correct
            }));
            return {
                id: player.id,
                name: player.name,
                className: player.isTeam ? '' : (player.className || ''),
                isTeam: !!player.isTeam,
                avatar: player.avatar,
                type: player.isTeam ? 'team' : 'kid',
                kidsMembersList: player.kidsMembersList || [player.name],
                scores: [scoreVal * 10, 0, 0],
                stageQuestionsAnswered: pLogs.length,
                sessionLogs: pLogs
            };
        };

        const nowIso = getLocalISODateString(new Date());
        match.isoDate = nowIso;
        if (!Array.isArray(globalGameHistory.sounds)) globalGameHistory.sounds = [];
        globalGameHistory.sounds.push({
            date: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('he-IL', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
            isoDate: nowIso,
            tournamentName: activeTournament.name,
            roundName: activeTournament.rounds[rIdx].roundName,
            playersSnapshot: [
                buildSnapshotForDuel(match.p1, p1Score, match.duelLogs),
                buildSnapshotForDuel(match.p2, p2Score, match.duelLogs)
            ],
            winnersNames: winner.name
        });

        saveToLocalStorage();
        updateHomeTournamentCardUI();
        playVictoryCelebrationSound();
        try { confetti({ particleCount: 240, spread: 130, origin: { y: 0.45 } }); } catch (e) {}

        document.getElementById('split-screen-container').style.display = 'none';
        const topBadgeBar = document.getElementById('top-badge-bar');
        if (topBadgeBar) topBadgeBar.style.display = 'flex';

        document.getElementById('victory-title').innerText = activeTournament.status === 'completed'
            ? `🏆 אלוף הטורניר: ${winner.name}! 🏆`
            : `המנצח בדו-קרב: ${winner.name}!`;
        document.getElementById('victory-winner-name').innerText = formatParticipantLabelWithClass(winner);
        document.getElementById('victory-details').innerText = `תוצאה סופית: ${match.p1.name} (${p1Score}) ⚡ ${match.p2.name} (${p2Score}). עץ הטורניר עודכן!`;
        document.getElementById('victory-modal').style.display = 'flex';
        activeDuelCtx = null;
    }

    function finishDuelAndReturnToTournament() {
        document.getElementById('victory-modal').style.display = 'none';
        openPublicTournamentModal();
    }

    function exitDuelToTournamentTree() {
        if (duelCountdownTimer) clearInterval(duelCountdownTimer);
        document.getElementById('split-screen-container').style.display = 'none';
        const topBadgeBar = document.getElementById('top-badge-bar');
        if (topBadgeBar) topBadgeBar.style.display = 'flex';
        activeDuelCtx = null;
        openPublicTournamentModal();
    }

    /* =========================================================================
       4. היסטוריית טורנירים תחת דוחות מערכת ("טורנירים") ותחקיר דו-קרב
       ========================================================================= */

    function isCancelledTournament(t) {
    if (!t || typeof t !== 'object') return true;
    const st = String(t.status || '').toLowerCase();
    return st === 'cancelled' || st === 'canceled' || t.status === 'מבוטל' || t.isCancelled === true || t.deleted === true;
}

function isTournamentTrulyCompleted(t) {
    if (!t || isCancelledTournament(t)) return false;
    const st = String(t.status || '').toLowerCase();
    const statusDone = (st === 'completed' || t.status === 'הסתיים');
    if (!statusDone) return false;
    if (t.champion && (t.champion.name || t.champion.id)) return true;
    if (Array.isArray(t.matches) && t.matches.length > 0 && t.matches.every(m => m.status === 'הסתיים' || m.status === 'completed')) return true;
    if (Array.isArray(t.rounds) && t.rounds.length > 0 && t.rounds.every(r => Array.isArray(r.matches) && r.matches.every(m => m.status === 'הסתיים' || m.status === 'completed'))) return true;
    return false;
}

function hasPlayedMatches(t) {
    if (!t || typeof t !== 'object') return false;
    if (Array.isArray(t.matches) && t.matches.some(m => m && (
        m.status === 'הסתיים' ||
        m.status === 'completed' ||
        m.played === true ||
        (Array.isArray(m.playerTimes) && m.playerTimes.length > 0) ||
        m.winner ||
        m.winnerId ||
        m.score != null
    ))) {
        return true;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(t.rounds) && t.rounds.some(r => Array.isArray(r.matches) && r.matches.some(m => m && (
        m.status === 'הסתיים' ||
        m.status === 'completed' ||
        m.played === true ||
        (Array.isArray(m.playerTimes) && m.playerTimes.length > 0) ||
        m.winner ||
        m.winnerId
    )))) {
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

function shouldIncludeTournamentInReports(t) {
    if (!t || isCancelledTournament(t)) return false;
    const isMemoryTourney = t.mode === 'memory' ||
        t.tournamentType === 'memory' ||
        t.tournamentCategory === 'memory' ||
        t.category === 'memory_only' ||
        String(t.gameType || '').startsWith('memory_') ||
        String(t.subMode || '').startsWith('tourney_');
    if (isMemoryTourney) {
        return isTournamentTrulyCompleted(t) || hasPlayedMatches(t);
    }
    return isTournamentTrulyCompleted(t);
}

function formatSecondsReadable(totalSec) {
    const secNum = Number(totalSec);
    if (!Number.isFinite(secNum) || secNum < 0) return '—';
    const rounded = Math.round(secNum);
    const mins = Math.floor(rounded / 60);
    const remSec = rounded % 60;
    const mm = String(mins).padStart(2, '0');
    const ss = String(remSec).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${mm}:${ss} (${rounded} שניות)`;
}

function getMemorySubModeLabel(subModeOrType) {
    const val = String(subModeOrType || '').toLowerCase();
    if (val.includes('single_time')) return '🧠 טורניר זיכרון • נגד השעון';
    if (val.includes('pairs_winner')) return '🧠 טורניר זיכרון • דו-קרב זוגות';
    return '🧠 טורניר זיכרון';
}

function getAllRecordedTournaments() {
    let list = [...(tournamentHistory || [])].filter(t => !isCancelledTournament(t));
    if (activeTournament && !isCancelledTournament(activeTournament) && activeTournament.status === 'active') {
        list.unshift(activeTournament);
    }
    if (typeof memoryTourneyManager !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(memoryTourneyManager.tournaments)) {
        memoryTourneyManager.tournaments.forEach(mt => {
            if (isCancelledTournament(mt)) return;
            const isCompleted = isTournamentTrulyCompleted(mt);
            const isSingleTime = (mt.subMode === 'tourney_single_time');
            const standings = memoryTourneyManager.getTournamentStandings ? memoryTourneyManager.getTournamentStandings(mt.id) : [];
            let resolvedParticipants = Array.isArray(mt.participants) && mt.participants.length > 0 ? mt.participants : [];
            if (resolvedParticipants.length === 0) {
                const seenIds = new Set();
                (mt.matches || []).forEach(m => {
                    (m.players || []).forEach(p => {
                        if (p && p.id && !seenIds.has(p.id)) {
                            seenIds.add(p.id);
                            resolvedParticipants.push(p);
                        }
                    });
                });
            }
            const normalizedRounds = [];
            if (isSingleTime) {
                normalizedRounds.push({
                    roundIdx: 0,
                    roundName: '⏱️ מקצי טורניר זיכרון נגד השעון',
                    matches: (mt.matches || []).map((m, idx) => {
                        const p1 = m.players?.[0] || { name: 'שחקן' };
                        const done = (m.status === 'הסתיים' || m.status === 'completed');
                        const formatted = m.formattedTime || formatSecondsReadable(m.timeSeconds);
                        const playerTimes = Array.isArray(m.playerTimes) && m.playerTimes.length > 0
                            ? [...m.playerTimes].sort((a, b) => (a.timeSeconds ?? Infinity) - (b.timeSeconds ?? Infinity))
                            : (done ? [{
                                playerId: p1.id,
                                playerName: p1.name,
                                avatar: p1.avatar || '🦁',
                                timeSeconds: m.timeSeconds,
                                formattedTime: formatted,
                                attempts: m.attempts || 0,
                                pairsFound: m.pairsFound || 0
                            }] : []);
                        return {
                            matchId: m.matchId || `mem_${idx}`,
                            p1: p1,
                            p2: null,
                            p1Score: done ? `${formatted} (${m.pairsFound || 0} זוגות • ${m.attempts || 0} ניסיונות)` : '-',
                            p2Score: '',
                            winner: done ? p1 : null,
                            gameType: 'memory_single_time',
                            subMode: 'tourney_single_time',
                            isMemorySingleTime: true,
                            timeSeconds: m.timeSeconds,
                            elapsedSeconds: m.timeSeconds,
                            formattedTime: formatted,
                            playerTimes: playerTimes,
                            attempts: m.attempts || 0,
                            pairsFound: m.pairsFound || 0,
                            status: done ? 'completed' : 'ready',
                            memoryLogs: m.memoryLogs || [],
                            duelLogs: []
                        };
                    })
                });
            } else {
                const roundIndices = Array.from(new Set((mt.matches || []).map(m => m.roundIdx || 0))).sort((a, b) => a - b);
                roundIndices.forEach(rIdx => {
                    const rMatches = (mt.matches || []).filter(m => (m.roundIdx || 0) === rIdx);
                    normalizedRounds.push({
                        roundIdx: rIdx,
                        roundName: rMatches[0]?.roundName || `שלב ${rIdx + 1}`,
                        matches: rMatches.map(m => {
                            const p1 = m.players?.[0] || null;
                            const p2 = m.players?.[1] || null;
                            const done = (m.status === 'הסתיים' || m.status === 'completed');
                            const winnerObj = done ? (m.players || []).find(x => x && x.id === m.winnerId) : null;
                            return {
                                matchId: m.matchId,
                                p1: p1,
                                p2: p2,
                                p1Score: (done && p1 && m.pairScores) ? m.pairScores[p1.id] : '-',
                                p2Score: (done && p2 && m.pairScores) ? m.pairScores[p2.id] : '-',
                                p1Attempts: (done && p1 && m.attemptCounts) ? m.attemptCounts[p1.id] : null,
                                p2Attempts: (done && p2 && m.attemptCounts) ? m.attemptCounts[p2.id] : null,
                                winner: winnerObj,
                                gameType: 'memory_pairs_winner',
                                subMode: 'tourney_pairs_winner',
                                elapsedSeconds: typeof m.elapsedSeconds === 'number' ? m.elapsedSeconds : null,
                                formattedTime: typeof m.elapsedSeconds === 'number' ? formatSecondsReadable(m.elapsedSeconds) : null,
                                status: done ? 'completed' : 'ready',
                                memoryLogs: m.memoryLogs || [],
                                duelLogs: []
                            };
                        })
                    });
                });
            }
            list.push({
                id: mt.id,
                name: mt.name,
                mode: 'memory',
                tournamentType: 'memory',
                tournamentCategory: 'memory',
                subMode: mt.subMode,
                size: mt.size || resolvedParticipants.length,
                participants: resolvedParticipants,
                gameTypes: [mt.subMode || 'memory'],
                rounds: normalizedRounds,
                standings: standings,
                status: isCompleted ? 'completed' : 'active',
                champion: mt.champion || null,
                createdAt: mt.createdAt || '',
                completedAt: mt.completedAt || mt.createdAt || ''
            });
        });
    }
    return list;
}

function getCompletedTournamentsOnly() {
    return getAllRecordedTournaments().filter(t => isTournamentTrulyCompleted(t));
}

function openMatchDebrief(tournId, rIdx, mIdx) {
    const allT = getAllRecordedTournaments();
    const tourn = allT.find(x => x.id === tournId);
    if (!tourn) return;
    const match = tourn.rounds[rIdx]?.matches?.[mIdx];
    if (!match) return;
    currentDebriefMatchRef = { tourn, round: tourn.rounds[rIdx], match };
    const isSingleMem = !!match.isMemorySingleTime || match.subMode === 'tourney_single_time' || match.gameType === 'memory_single_time';
    const isPairsMem = !isSingleMem && (match.subMode === 'tourney_pairs_winner' || match.gameType === 'memory_pairs_winner' || tourn.mode === 'memory');
    document.getElementById('debrief-title').innerText = isSingleMem
        ? `📊 נתוני מקצה זיכרון נגד השעון: ${match.p1?.name || ''}`
        : `📊 נתוני משחק: ${match.p1?.name || ''} מול ${match.p2?.name || ''}`;
    let html = '';
    if (isSingleMem) {
        const rankedTimes = Array.isArray(match.playerTimes) && match.playerTimes.length > 0
            ? [...match.playerTimes].sort((a, b) => (a.timeSeconds ?? Infinity) - (b.timeSeconds ?? Infinity))
            : [{
                playerName: match.p1?.name || 'שחקן',
                timeSeconds: match.timeSeconds,
                formattedTime: match.formattedTime || formatSecondsReadable(match.timeSeconds),
                attempts: match.attempts || 0,
                pairsFound: match.pairsFound || 0
            }];
        html += `<div style="background:#f5f3ff; border:1px solid #c4b5fd; padding:10px; border-radius:10px; margin-bottom:10px;">
            <b>טורניר:</b> ${tourn.name} | <b>סוג:</b> ${getMemorySubModeLabel(tourn.subMode)}<br>
            <b>שלב:</b> ${tourn.rounds[rIdx].roundName} | <b>סטטוס מקצה:</b> ${match.status === 'completed' ? '✅ הושלם' : '⏳ ממתין'}
        </div>
        <table class="scoreboard-table" style="font-size:11.5px; margin-bottom:10px;">
            <tr><th>דירוג</th><th>שם שחקן</th><th>זמן מדויק</th><th>ניסיונות</th><th>זוגות שנמצאו</th></tr>`;
        rankedTimes.forEach((pt, idx) => {
            const medal = idx === 0 ? '🥇 1' : (idx === 1 ? '🥈 2' : (idx === 2 ? '🥉 3' : `${idx + 1}`));
            const timeDisp = pt.formattedTime || formatSecondsReadable(pt.timeSeconds);
            html += `<tr>
                <td style="text-align:center;"><b>${medal}</b></td>
                <td><b>${pt.playerName}</b></td>
                <td><b>${timeDisp}</b></td>
                <td>${pt.attempts ?? '-'}</td>
                <td>${pt.pairsFound ?? '-'}</td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        html += `</table>`;
    } else if (isPairsMem) {
        const durText = match.formattedTime || (typeof match.elapsedSeconds === 'number' ? formatSecondsReadable(match.elapsedSeconds) : null);
        html += `<div style="background:#f5f3ff; border:1px solid #c4b5fd; padding:10px; border-radius:10px; margin-bottom:10px;">
            <b>טורניר:</b> ${tourn.name} | <b>סוג:</b> ${getMemorySubModeLabel(tourn.subMode)}<br>
            <b>שלב:</b> ${tourn.rounds[rIdx].roundName} | <b>מנצח במקצה:</b> 🏆 ${match.winner?.name || '-'}${durText ? ` | <b>⏱️ משך:</b> ${durText}` : ''}
        </div>
        <table class="scoreboard-table" style="font-size:11.5px; margin-bottom:10px;">
            <tr><th>מתמודד</th><th>זוגות שנמצאו</th><th>מספר ניסיונות</th><th>תוצאה</th></tr>
            <tr>
                <td><b>${match.p1?.name || '-'}</b></td>
                <td><b>${match.p1Score ?? '-'}</b></td>
                <td>${match.p1Attempts ?? '-'}</td>
                <td>${match.winner?.id === match.p1?.id ? '🏆 מנצח' : '—'}</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <td><b>${match.p2?.name || '-'}</b></td>
                <td><b>${match.p2Score ?? '-'}</b></td>
                <td>${match.p2Attempts ?? '-'}</td>
                <td>${match.winner?.id === match.p2?.id ? '🏆 מנצח' : '—'}</td>
            </tr>
        </table>`;
    } else {
        const durationLine = (typeof match.elapsedSeconds === 'number') ? ` | <b>⏱️ משך המשחק:</b> ${formatSecondsReadable(match.elapsedSeconds)}` : '';
        html += `<div style="background:#e0fbfc; padding:10px; border-radius:10px; margin-bottom:10px;">
            <b>טורניר:</b> ${tourn.name} | <b>שלב:</b> ${tourn.rounds[rIdx].roundName}<br>
            <b>תוצאה:</b> ${match.p1.name} (${match.p1Score}) - ${match.p2.name} (${match.p2Score}) | <b>מנצח:</b> 🏆 ${match.winner?.name || '-'}${durationLine}
        </div>`;
    }
    if (match.memoryLogs && match.memoryLogs.length > 0) {
        html += `<table class="scoreboard-table" style="font-size:11px;">
            <tr><th>מהלך #</th><th>שחקן/ית</th><th>קלף 1</th><th>קלף 2</th><th>זמן</th><th>תוצאה</th></tr>`;
        match.memoryLogs.forEach(ml => {
            const resTxt = ml.isMatch ? '✅ זוג תואם (+1)' : '❌ לא תואם';
            const timeTxt = ml.timeAtMove !== null ? formatSecondsReadable(ml.timeAtMove) : '-';
            html += `<tr>
                <td style="text-align:center;">${ml.moveNum}</td>
                <td><b>${ml.playerName}</b></td>
                <td style="font-weight:bold;">${ml.card1}</td>
                <td style="font-weight:bold;">${ml.card2}</td>
                <td>${timeTxt}</td>
                <td>${resTxt}</td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        html += `</table>`;
    } else if (match.duelLogs && match.duelLogs.length > 0) {
        html += `<table class="scoreboard-table" style="font-size:11px;">
            <tr><th>שאלה #</th><th>זמן</th><th>משחק</th><th>שאלה / רמז</th><th>מתמודד</th><th>בחירה</th><th>תוצאה</th></tr>`;
        match.duelLogs.forEach(l => {
            const st = l.correct ? '✅ נכון (+1)' : `❌ שגוי (Freeze | תשובה: ${l.correctAnswer})`;
            html += `<tr>
                <td style="text-align:center;">${l.questionNum}</td>
                <td>${l.timestamp || '-'}</td>
                <td>${getGameLabelById(l.gameType || match.gameType)}</td>
                <td>${l.target} (${l.hint})</td>
                <td><b>${l.playerName}</b></td>
                <td><b>${l.chosen}</b></td>
                <td>${st}</td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        html += `</table>`;
    }
    document.getElementById('debrief-body').innerHTML = html;
    document.getElementById('match-debrief-modal').style.display = 'flex';
}


    function escapePdfHtml(val) {
        return String(val ?? '')
            .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
            .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
            .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
            .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
            .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }

    let pendingPrintTimer = null;
    let pendingTitleRestoreTimer = null;
    let originalDocTitleBeforePrint = null;

    function buildStandalonePrintDocumentHtml(safeHtml, docTitle, isCertExport) {
        const pageRule = isCertExport
            ? "@page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 10mm; }"
            : "@page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 12mm; }";
        return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="he" dir="rtl">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>${escapePdfHtml(docTitle)}</title>
    <style>
        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
            print-color-adjust: exact !important;
        }
        ${pageRule}
        html, body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            background: #ffffff;
            color: #03045e;
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
            direction: rtl;
            text-align: right;
            width: 100%;
        }
        #print-root {
            padding: 8px;
            width: 100%;
        }
        .print-section { margin-bottom: 18px; }
        .print-section h3, .print-section h4 { page-break-after: avoid; break-after: avoid; }
        .print-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 11px; }
        .print-table thead { display: table-header-group; }
        .print-table tr { page-break-inside: avoid; break-inside: avoid; }
        .print-header {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #03045e, #0077b6);
            color: #ffffff;
            padding: 14px 16px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            page-break-inside: avoid;
            break-inside: avoid;
        }
        .print-table th, .print-table td { border: 1px solid #90e0ef; padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center; word-break: break-word; }
        .print-table th { background: #e0fbfc; color: #03045e; font-weight: bold; }
        .print-table th:first-child, .print-table td:first-child { text-align: right; }
        .cert-page {
            border: 8px double #f59e0b;
            border-radius: 18px;
            padding: 28px 32px;
            text-align: center;
            background: #fffbeb;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            width: 100%;
            min-height: 160mm;
            display: block;
            margin: 0 0 12mm 0;
            page-break-inside: avoid;
            break-inside: avoid;
            page-break-after: always;
            break-after: page;
        }
        .cert-page:last-child {
            margin-bottom: 0;
            page-break-after: auto;
            break-after: auto;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="print-root">${safeHtml}</div>
    <script>
        window.addEventListener('load', function () {
            setTimeout(function () {
                try {
                    window.focus();
                    window.print();
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('Standalone print error:', e);
                }
            }, 150);
        });
    <\/script>
</body>
</html>`;
    }

    function triggerPrintExport(exportContainer, htmlContent, customPrintTitle = null) {
        if (pendingPrintTimer) {
            clearTimeout(pendingPrintTimer);
            pendingPrintTimer = null;
        }
        if (pendingTitleRestoreTimer) {
            clearTimeout(pendingTitleRestoreTimer);
            pendingTitleRestoreTimer = null;
        }
        if (originalDocTitleBeforePrint === null) {
            originalDocTitleBeforePrint = document.title;
        }
        const isCertExport = customPrintTitle ? false : /class="cert-page"/.test(String(htmlContent || ''));
        const resolvedTitle = customPrintTitle || (isCertExport ? 'English_With_Friends_Certificates' : 'English_With_Friends_Report');
        document.title = resolvedTitle;

        const safeHtml = (htmlContent && String(htmlContent).trim().length > 0)
            ? String(htmlContent)
            : '<div class="print-header"><h2>English With Friends</h2><p>אין נתונים להצגה בדוח זה.</p></div>';

        if (exportContainer) {
            exportContainer.innerHTML = safeHtml;
            exportContainer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
            void exportContainer.offsetHeight;
        }

        const restoreTitleLater = () => {
            if (pendingTitleRestoreTimer) clearTimeout(pendingTitleRestoreTimer);
            pendingTitleRestoreTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                pendingTitleRestoreTimer = null;
                if (originalDocTitleBeforePrint !== null) {
                    document.title = originalDocTitleBeforePrint;
                    originalDocTitleBeforePrint = null;
                }
            }, 1500);
        };

        // 1. פתיחת חלון הדפסה ייעודי ועצמאי המבטיח שהתוכן מרונדר במלואו לפני פתיחת תיבת ההדפסה
        try {
            const printWin = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=1024,height=768');
            if (printWin && printWin.document) {
                const standaloneDoc = buildStandalonePrintDocumentHtml(safeHtml, resolvedTitle, isCertExport);
                printWin.document.open();
                printWin.document.write(standaloneDoc);
                printWin.document.close();
                restoreTitleLater();
                return;
            }
        } catch (popupErr) {
            console.warn('Popup print window blocked/unavailable, falling back to inline print:', popupErr);
        }

        // 2. גיבוי אוטומטי להדפסה מתוך העמוד הנוכחי אם חלון קופץ נחסם בדפדפן
        if (!exportContainer) return;
        const runInlinePrint = () => {
            pendingPrintTimer = null;
            try {
                void exportContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
                window.print();
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Print error:', e);
            } finally {
                restoreTitleLater();
            }
        };
        if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    pendingPrintTimer = setTimeout(runInlinePrint, 180);
                });
            });
        } else {
            pendingPrintTimer = setTimeout(runInlinePrint, 220);
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener('afterprint', () => {
        if (pendingTitleRestoreTimer) clearTimeout(pendingTitleRestoreTimer);
        pendingTitleRestoreTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            pendingTitleRestoreTimer = null;
            if (originalDocTitleBeforePrint !== null) {
                document.title = originalDocTitleBeforePrint;
                originalDocTitleBeforePrint = null;
            }
        }, 800);
    });

function exportSingleMatchDebriefPDF() {
    if (!currentDebriefMatchRef) return;
    const { tourn, round, match } = currentDebriefMatchRef;
    const exportContainer = document.getElementById('pdf-export-view');
    if (!exportContainer) return;
    const isSingleMem = !!match.isMemorySingleTime || match.subMode === 'tourney_single_time';
    const isPairsMem = !isSingleMem && (match.subMode === 'tourney_pairs_winner' || tourn.mode === 'memory');
    const subTitle = tourn.mode === 'memory' ? getMemorySubModeLabel(tourn.subMode) : getTournamentGameDisplayInfo(tourn).headerGamesSummary;
    let html = `
        <div class="print-header">
            <h2>🏆 נתוני מקצה בטורניר • ${escapePdfHtml(tourn.name)}</h2>
            <p>${escapePdfHtml(round.roundName)} | ${escapePdfHtml(subTitle)}</p>
        </div>`;
    if (isSingleMem) {
        const rankedTimes = Array.isArray(match.playerTimes) && match.playerTimes.length > 0
            ? [...match.playerTimes].sort((a, b) => (a.timeSeconds ?? Infinity) - (b.timeSeconds ?? Infinity))
            : [{
                playerName: match.p1?.name || 'שחקן',
                timeSeconds: match.timeSeconds,
                formattedTime: match.formattedTime || formatSecondsReadable(match.timeSeconds),
                attempts: match.attempts || 0,
                pairsFound: match.pairsFound || 0
            }];
        html += `<div class="print-section">
            <h3>⏱️ דירוג ותוצאות מקצה נגד השעון</h3>
            <table class="print-table">
                <thead><tr><th>דירוג</th><th>שם שחקן</th><th>זמן מדויק</th><th>ניסיונות</th><th>זוגות שנמצאו</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>`;
        rankedTimes.forEach((pt, idx) => {
            html += `<tr>
                <td>${idx + 1}</td>
                <td><b>${escapePdfHtml(pt.playerName)}</b></td>
                <td><b>${escapePdfHtml(pt.formattedTime || formatSecondsReadable(pt.timeSeconds))}</b></td>
                <td>${escapePdfHtml(pt.attempts ?? '-')}</td>
                <td>${escapePdfHtml(pt.pairsFound ?? '-')}</td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        html += `</tbody></table></div>`;
    } else if (isPairsMem) {
        html += `<div class="print-section">
            <h3>⚔️ סיכום דו-קרב זיכרון</h3>
            <table class="print-table">
                <thead><tr><th>מתמודד</th><th>זוגות שנמצאו</th><th>מספר ניסיונות</th><th>מנצח</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>
                <tr><td><b>${escapePdfHtml(match.p1?.name || '-')}</b></td><td>${escapePdfHtml(match.p1Score ?? '-')}</td><td>${escapePdfHtml(match.p1Attempts ?? '-')}</td><td>${match.winner?.id === match.p1?.id ? '👑 כן' : '-'}</td></tr>
                <tr><td><b>${escapePdfHtml(match.p2?.name || '-')}</b></td><td>${escapePdfHtml(match.p2Score ?? '-')}</td><td>${escapePdfHtml(match.p2Attempts ?? '-')}</td><td>${match.winner?.id === match.p2?.id ? '👑 כן' : '-'}</td></tr>
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>`;
    } else {
        html += `<div class="print-section">
            <h3>📊 סיכום תוצאות הדו-קרב</h3>
            <p><b>מתמודד 1:</b> ${escapePdfHtml(formatParticipantLabelWithClass(match.p1))} — <b>${escapePdfHtml(match.p1Score)} נקודות</b></p>
            <p><b>מתמודד 2:</b> ${escapePdfHtml(formatParticipantLabelWithClass(match.p2))} — <b>${escapePdfHtml(match.p2Score)} נקודות</b></p>
            <p><b>מנצח/ת הדו-קרב:</b> 👑 ${escapePdfHtml(match.winner?.name || '-')}</p>
        </div>`;
    }
    if (match.memoryLogs && match.memoryLogs.length > 0) {
        html += `<div class="print-section">
            <h3>📋 פירוט מהלכי הזיכרון</h3>
            <table class="print-table">
                <thead><tr><th>מהלך</th><th>שחקן</th><th>קלף 1</th><th>קלף 2</th><th>זמן</th><th>תוצאה</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>`;
        match.memoryLogs.forEach(ml => {
            html += `<tr>
                <td>${escapePdfHtml(ml.moveNum)}</td>
                <td><b>${escapePdfHtml(ml.playerName)}</b></td>
                <td>${escapePdfHtml(ml.card1)}</td>
                <td>${escapePdfHtml(ml.card2)}</td>
                <td>${ml.timeAtMove !== null && ml.timeAtMove !== undefined ? escapePdfHtml(formatSecondsReadable(ml.timeAtMove)) : '-'}</td>
                <td>${ml.isMatch ? '✅ זוג תואם' : '❌ לא תואם'}</td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        html += `</tbody></table></div>`;
    } else if (match.duelLogs && match.duelLogs.length > 0) {
        html += `<div class="print-section">
            <h3>📋 פירוט שאלות, תשובות וזמנים</h3>
            <table class="print-table">
                <thead><tr><th>שאלה</th><th>זמן</th><th>שאלה / רמז</th><th>מתמודד</th><th>בחירה</th><th>סטטוס</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>`;
        match.duelLogs.forEach(l => {
            html += `<tr>
                <td>${escapePdfHtml(l.questionNum)}</td>
                <td>${escapePdfHtml(l.timestamp || '-')}</td>
                <td>${escapePdfHtml(l.target)} (${escapePdfHtml(l.hint)})</td>
                <td><b>${escapePdfHtml(l.playerName)}</b></td>
                <td><b>${escapePdfHtml(l.chosen)}</b></td>
                <td>${l.correct ? '✅ נכון' : `❌ שגוי (${escapePdfHtml(l.correctAnswer)})`}</td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        html += `</tbody></table></div>`;
    }
    triggerPrintExport(exportContainer, html);
}

    /* =========================================================================
       5. תעודות הוקרה (בתוך דוחות מערכת)
       ========================================================================= */

    function renderCertificatesPanel() {
        const container = document.getElementById('certs-list-container');
        if (!container) return;
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('cert-tournament-search');
        const query = (searchInput ? searchInput.value : '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const completedT = getCompletedTournamentsOnly();

        if (completedT.length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML = `<p style="font-size:12px; color:#666; text-align:center; padding:15px;">תעודות הוקרה ניתנות אך ורק לאחר סיום טורניר.</p>`;
            return;
        }

        const filteredT = completedT.filter(t => {
            if (!query) return true;
            const tName = (t.name || '').toLowerCase();
            const tDate = ((t.completedAt || '') + ' ' + (t.createdAt || '')).toLowerCase();
            const champName = (t.champion?.name || '').toLowerCase();
            const entries = buildCertificateEntriesForTournament(t);
            const entriesText = entries.map(c => `${c.recipientName} ${c.kidClass || ''} ${c.teamName || ''} ${(c.teamMembers || []).join(' ')}`).join(' ').toLowerCase();
            const partsText = (t.participants || []).map(p => `${p.name} ${p.subtitle || ''} ${p.className || ''} ${p.classDesc || ''}`).join(' ').toLowerCase();
            return tName.includes(query) || tDate.includes(query) || champName.includes(query) || entriesText.includes(query) || partsText.includes(query);
        });

        if (filteredT.length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML = `<p style="font-size:12px; color:#666; text-align:center; padding:15px;">לא נמצאו טורנירים התואמים למילות החיפוש.</p>`;
            return;
        }

        let html = '';
        filteredT.forEach(tourn => {
            const certEntries = buildCertificateEntriesForTournament(tourn);
            html += `<div style="background:#fffbeb; border:1.5px solid #f59e0b; border-radius:12px; padding:10px; margin-bottom:10px; text-align:right;">
                <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding-bottom:8px; margin-bottom:8px; border-bottom:1.5px dashed #fcd34d;">
                    <div>
                        <b style="color:#92400e; font-size:13.5px;">🏆 ${tourn.name}</b>
                        <div style="font-size:11px; color:#555;">הסתיים: ${tourn.completedAt || tourn.createdAt}</div>
                    </div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-action" onclick="exportAllCertificatesBatchForTournament('${tourn.id}')" style="background:#2a9d8f; padding:7px 11px; font-size:11.5px; flex-shrink:0;">📥 Batch Export (כל התעודות)</button>
                </div>`;

            certEntries.forEach((c, idx) => {
                const roleBadge = c.isChampion
                    ? `<span style="background:#fef3c7; color:#92400e; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:6px; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:bold;">👑 אלוף/ת הטורניר</span>`
                    : `<span style="background:#e0fbfc; color:#0077b6; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:6px; font-size:10.5px;">משתתף/ת בטורניר</span>`;
                const groupNote = c.teamName
                    ? `<div style="font-size:11px; color:#555;">קבוצה: <b>${c.teamName}</b> | חברי הקבוצה: ${c.teamMembers.join(', ')}</div>`
                    : `<div style="font-size:11px; color:#555;">כיתה: <b>${c.kidClass}</b></div>`;

                html += `<div style="background:white; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:10px; padding:8px 10px; margin-bottom:6px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
                    <div>
                        <div>${c.avatar} <b>${c.recipientName}</b> ${roleBadge}</div>
                        ${groupNote}
                    </div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-action" onclick="exportSingleCertByIndex('${tourn.id}', ${idx})" style="background:#0077b6; font-size:11px; padding:6px 10px;">📜 הפק תעודה</button>
                </div>`;
            });

            html += `</div>`;
        });

        container.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function exportSingleCertByIndex(tournId, idx) {
        const chosenT = getCompletedTournamentsOnly().find(x => x.id === tournId);
        if (!chosenT || chosenT.status !== 'completed') return;
        const entries = buildCertificateEntriesForTournament(chosenT);
        if (entries[idx]) exportCertificatesListPDF([entries[idx]]);
    }

    function buildCertificateEntriesForTournament(tourn) {
        if (!tourn || tourn.status !== 'completed') return [];
        let entries = [];
        const champId = tourn.champion ? tourn.champion.id : null;

        (tourn.participants || []).forEach(p => {
            const isChamp = (champId && p.id === champId);
            if (p.isTeam) {
                const members = (p.kidsMembersList && p.kidsMembersList.length > 0) ? p.kidsMembersList : [p.name];
                members.forEach(memberName => {
                    const kidRec = registeredKids.find(k => k.name === memberName);
                    entries.push({
                        recipientName: memberName,
                        kidClass: kidRec ? formatClassDisplay(kidRec.classLetter, kidRec.classNum) : '',
                        avatar: kidRec ? kidRec.avatar : p.avatar,
                        teamName: p.name,
                        teamMembers: members,
                        tournamentName: tourn.name,
                        dateStr: tourn.completedAt || tourn.createdAt,
                        isChampion: isChamp
                    });
                });
            } else {
                const kidRec = registeredKids.find(k => k.id === p.id || k.name === p.name);
                const clsStr = kidRec ? formatClassDisplay(kidRec.classLetter, kidRec.classNum) : (p.className || 'ללא');
                entries.push({
                    recipientName: p.name,
                    kidClass: clsStr,
                    avatar: p.avatar,
                    teamName: null,
                    teamMembers: [],
                    tournamentName: tourn.name,
                    dateStr: tourn.completedAt || tourn.createdAt,
                    isChampion: isChamp
                });
            }
        });
        return entries;
    }

    function exportAllCertificatesBatchForTournament(tournId) {
        const completedT = getCompletedTournamentsOnly();
        const chosenT = completedT.find(x => x.id === tournId) || completedT[0];
        if (!chosenT) return;
        const entries = buildCertificateEntriesForTournament(chosenT);
        exportCertificatesListPDF(entries);
    }

    function exportAllCertificatesBatch() {
        const completedT = getCompletedTournamentsOnly();
        const chosenT = completedT[0];
        if (!chosenT) return;
        const entries = buildCertificateEntriesForTournament(chosenT);
        exportCertificatesListPDF(entries);
    }


    let currentCertSubMode = 'tournaments';
    let currentCertScoreboardDateMode = 'period';
    let lastFilteredScoreboardCertRows = [];

    function getLocalISODateString(d) {
        const dt = d instanceof Date ? d : new Date();
        const y = dt.getFullYear();
        const m = String(dt.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        const day = String(dt.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
        return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
    }

    function formatISOToDisplayDate(isoStr) {
        if (!isoStr || typeof isoStr !== 'string') return '';
        const parts = isoStr.slice(0, 10).split('-');
        if (parts.length !== 3) return isoStr;
        return `${parts[2]}.${parts[1]}.${parts[0]}`;
    }

    function extractRecordISODate(rec, fallbackIso = '2026-11-14') {
        if (!rec || typeof rec !== 'object') return fallbackIso;
        if (rec.isoDate && typeof rec.isoDate === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(rec.isoDate)) {
            return rec.isoDate.slice(0, 10);
        }
        const candidates = [rec.completedAt, rec.createdAt, rec.date];
        for (const c of candidates) {
            if (!c || typeof c !== 'string') continue;
            const dmy = c.match(/(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})/);
            if (dmy) {
                const dd = dmy[1].padStart(2, '0');
                const mm = dmy[2].padStart(2, '0');
                const yyyy = dmy[3];
                return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
            }
            const ymd = c.match(/(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
            if (ymd) return `${ymd[1]}-${ymd[2]}-${ymd[3]}`;
        }
        return fallbackIso;
    }

    function getSystemStartISODate() {
        const todayIso = getLocalISODateString(new Date());
        let earliest = todayIso;
        for (let gKey in globalGameHistory) {
            (globalGameHistory[gKey] || []).forEach(sess => {
                const d = extractRecordISODate(sess, todayIso);
                if (d && d < earliest) earliest = d;
            });
        }
        (getAllRecordedTournaments() || []).forEach(t => {
            const d = extractRecordISODate(t, todayIso);
            if (d && d < earliest) earliest = d;
        });
        return earliest;
    }

    function buildAvailablePeriodOptions(periodType) {
        const startIso = getSystemStartISODate();
        const todayIso = getLocalISODateString(new Date());
        const startD = new Date(startIso + 'T12:00:00');
        const endD = new Date(todayIso + 'T12:00:00');
        const options = [];

        if (periodType === 'annual') {
            const startY = startD.getFullYear();
            const endY = endD.getFullYear();
            for (let y = endY; y >= startY; y--) {
                options.push({
                    value: `${y}-01-01|${y}-12-31`,
                    startDate: `${y}-01-01`,
                    endDate: `${y}-12-31`,
                    label: `שנת ${y}`
                });
            }
        } else if (periodType === 'monthly') {
            const hebrewMonths = ['ינואר', 'פברואר', 'מרץ', 'אפריל', 'מאי', 'יוני', 'יולי', 'אוגוסט', 'ספטמבר', 'אוקטובר', 'נובמבר', 'דצמבר'];
            let curY = endD.getFullYear();
            let curM = endD.getMonth();
            const minY = startD.getFullYear();
            const minM = startD.getMonth();
            while (curY > minY || (curY === minY && curM >= minM)) {
                const mm = String(curM + 1).padStart(2, '0');
                const lastDay = new Date(curY, curM + 1, 0).getDate();
                const sDate = `${curY}-${mm}-01`;
                const eDate = `${curY}-${mm}-${String(lastDay).padStart(2, '0')}`;
                options.push({
                    value: `${sDate}|${eDate}`,
                    startDate: sDate,
                    endDate: eDate,
                    label: `${hebrewMonths[curM]} ${curY} (${mm}/${curY})`
                });
                curM--;
                if (curM < 0) { curM = 11; curY--; }
            }
        } else {
            // שבוע: מיום ראשון עד יום שבת כולל, ומשויך לחודש שבו חל יום ראשון של אותו שבוע
            const hebrewMonths = ['ינואר', 'פברואר', 'מרץ', 'אפריל', 'מאי', 'יוני', 'יולי', 'אוגוסט', 'ספטמבר', 'אוקטובר', 'נובמבר', 'דצמבר'];
            // Find Sunday of startD week
            const firstSunday = new Date(startD);
            firstSunday.setDate(firstSunday.getDate() - firstSunday.getDay());
            // Find Sunday of endD week
            const lastSunday = new Date(endD);
            lastSunday.setDate(lastSunday.getDate() - lastSunday.getDay());

            let curSun = new Date(lastSunday);
            while (curSun >= firstSunday) {
                const curSat = new Date(curSun);
                curSat.setDate(curSat.getDate() + 6);
                const sIso = getLocalISODateString(curSun);
                const eIso = getLocalISODateString(curSat);
                const sunMonthName = hebrewMonths[curSun.getMonth()];
                const sunYear = curSun.getFullYear();
                options.push({
                    value: `${sIso}|${eIso}`,
                    startDate: sIso,
                    endDate: eIso,
                    label: `א ${formatISOToDisplayDate(sIso)} – ש ${formatISOToDisplayDate(eIso)}`
                });
                curSun.setDate(curSun.getDate() - 7);
            }
        }
        return options;
    }

    function populatePeriodOptionsDropdown() {
        const periodType = document.getElementById('cert-sb-period-type')?.value || 'weekly';
        const optSelect = document.getElementById('cert-sb-period-option');
        if (!optSelect) return;
        const prevVal = optSelect.value;
        const opts = buildAvailablePeriodOptions(periodType);
        optSelect.innerHTML = opts.map(o => `<option value="${o.value}">${o.label}</option>`).join('');
        if (prevVal && opts.some(o => o.value === prevVal)) {
            optSelect.value = prevVal;
        }
    }

    function switchCertSubMode(subMode) {
        currentCertSubMode = subMode;
        const btnT = document.getElementById('cert-subtab-tournaments');
        const btnS = document.getElementById('cert-subtab-scoreboard');
        const secT = document.getElementById('certs-tournaments-section');
        const secS = document.getElementById('certs-scoreboard-section');
        if (btnT) btnT.classList.toggle('active-tab', subMode === 'tournaments');
        if (btnS) btnS.classList.toggle('active-tab', subMode === 'scoreboard');
        if (secT) secT.style.display = subMode === 'tournaments' ? 'flex' : 'none';
        if (secS) secS.style.display = subMode === 'scoreboard' ? 'flex' : 'none';

        if (subMode === 'tournaments') {
            renderCertificatesPanel();
        } else {
            initCertScoreboardDefaultDatesIfEmpty();
            populatePeriodOptionsDropdown();
            renderScoreboardCertificatesPanel();
        }
    }

    function initCertScoreboardDefaultDatesIfEmpty() {
        const todayIso = getLocalISODateString(new Date());
        const sysStartIso = getSystemStartISODate();
        const startEl = document.getElementById('cert-sb-start-date');
        const endEl = document.getElementById('cert-sb-end-date');
        if (startEl && !startEl.value) startEl.value = sysStartIso;
        if (endEl && !endEl.value) endEl.value = todayIso;
    }

    function onCertPeriodTypeChange() {
        populatePeriodOptionsDropdown();
        renderScoreboardCertificatesPanel();
    }

    function setCertScoreboardDateMode(mode) {
        currentCertScoreboardDateMode = mode;
        const btnPeriod = document.getElementById('cert-date-mode-period');
        const btnRange = document.getElementById('cert-date-mode-range');
        const periodBox = document.getElementById('cert-sb-period-box');
        const rangeBox = document.getElementById('cert-sb-range-box');
        const hintEl = document.getElementById('cert-sb-mode-hint');

        if (btnPeriod) btnPeriod.classList.toggle('active-mode', mode === 'period');
        if (btnRange) btnRange.classList.toggle('active-mode', mode === 'range');
        if (periodBox) periodBox.style.display = mode === 'period' ? 'flex' : 'none';
        if (rangeBox) rangeBox.style.display = mode === 'range' ? 'flex' : 'none';
        if (hintEl) {
            hintEl.innerText = mode === 'period'
                ? 'ℹ️ מציג את השלישייה המובילה לתקופה שנבחרה מתוך התקופות הפעילות במערכת.'
                : 'ℹ️ מחשב את השלישייה המובילה אך ורק בטווח התאריכים שנבחר (ברירת מחדל: מתחילת המערכת ועד היום).';
        }
        initCertScoreboardDefaultDatesIfEmpty();
        if (mode === 'period') populatePeriodOptionsDropdown();
        renderScoreboardCertificatesPanel();
    }

    function renderScoreboardCertificatesPanel() {
        const container = document.getElementById('cert-sb-leaderboard-container');
        if (!container) return;
        initCertScoreboardDefaultDatesIfEmpty();

        let dateFilter = null;
        let periodLabel = '';

        if (currentCertScoreboardDateMode === 'period') {
            const optSelect = document.getElementById('cert-sb-period-option');
            if (!optSelect || optSelect.options.length === 0) populatePeriodOptionsDropdown();
            const val = optSelect?.value || '';
            const selectedText = optSelect?.options[optSelect.selectedIndex]?.text || '';
            const [sDate, eDate] = val.split('|');
            dateFilter = { mode: 'range', startDate: sDate, endDate: eDate };
            periodLabel = selectedText || `${formatISOToDisplayDate(sDate)} – ${formatISOToDisplayDate(eDate)}`;
        } else {
            let startVal = document.getElementById('cert-sb-start-date')?.value || getSystemStartISODate();
            let endVal = document.getElementById('cert-sb-end-date')?.value || getLocalISODateString(new Date());
            if (startVal > endVal) {
                const tmp = startVal; startVal = endVal; endVal = tmp;
            }
            dateFilter = { mode: 'range', startDate: startVal, endDate: endVal };
            periodLabel = `טווח תאריכים: ${formatISOToDisplayDate(startVal)} – ${formatISOToDisplayDate(endVal)}`;
        }

        const statsList = calculateComprehensiveStats(dateFilter);
        const activeTop3 = statsList.filter(it => it.rank <= 3 && (it.trophies > 0 || it.totalWins > 0 || it.totalScore > 0));
        lastFilteredScoreboardCertRows = activeTop3;

        let html = `
            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:8px; padding-bottom:6px; border-bottom:1.5px solid #90e0ef;">
                <div style="font-size:11.5px; color:#03045e;"><b>${periodLabel}</b></div>
                ${activeTop3.length > 0 ? `<button type="button" class="btn-action" onclick="exportTop3ScoreboardCertificatesPDF()" style="background:#f59e0b; color:#03045e; padding:6px 10px; font-size:11px; flex-shrink:0;">🥇🥈🥉 הפק כל התעודות יחד</button>` : ''}
            </div>
        `;

        if (activeTop3.length === 0) {
            html += `<p style="font-size:12px; color:#64748b; text-align:center; padding:12px;">לא נצברו נקודות או נצחונות בתקופה שנבחרה.</p>`;
            container.innerHTML = html;
            return;
        }

        html += `<table class="scoreboard-table" style="font-size:11.5px; margin:0;">
            <tr>
                <th>מקום</th>
                <th>שחקן / קבוצה</th>
                <th>🏆 | 🏅 | ⭐</th>
                <th>תעודה</th>
            </tr>`;

        activeTop3.forEach((it, idx) => {
            const rowBg = it.rank === 1 ? '#fef3c7' : (it.rank === 2 ? '#f1f5f9' : '#ffedd5');
            const rankMedal = it.rank === 1 ? ' 🥇' : (it.rank === 2 ? ' 🥈' : ' 🥉');

            let descBadge = '';
            if (it.isTeam) {
                const tObj = registeredTeams.find(t => t.name === it.name);
                const d = tObj ? tObj.classDesc : it.classDesc;
                descBadge = d ? ` (קבוצה - ${d})` : ` (קבוצה)`;
            } else {
                const kObj = registeredKids.find(k => k.name === it.name);
                const cls = kObj ? formatClassDisplay(kObj.classLetter, kObj.classNum) : it.className;
                descBadge = cls && cls !== 'ללא' ? ` (כיתה ${cls})` : '';
            }

            html += `<tr style="background:${rowBg};">
                <td style="text-align:center; font-weight:bold;">${it.rank}${rankMedal}</td>
                <td><b>${it.name}</b>${descBadge}</td>
                <td><b>${it.trophies}</b> 🏆 | <b>${it.totalWins}</b> 🏅 | <b>${it.totalScore}</b> ⭐</td>
                <td><button type="button" class="btn-action" onclick="exportScoreboardCertByRowIndex(${idx})" style="background:#0077b6; font-size:10.5px; padding:4px 8px;">📜 הפק תעודה</button></td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        html += `</table>`;
        container.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function buildScoreboardCertEntriesForRow(rowItem) {
        if (!rowItem) return [];
        const periodType = document.getElementById('cert-sb-period-type')?.value || 'weekly';
        const periodTitleMap = {
            weekly: 'תעודת הצטיינות שבועית',
            monthly: 'תעודת הצטיינות חודשית',
            annual: 'תעודת הצטיינות שנתית'
        };
        const baseTitle = currentCertScoreboardDateMode === 'period'
            ? (periodTitleMap[periodType] || 'תעודת הצטיינות')
            : 'תעודת הצטיינות והוקרה';
        const rankEmoji = rowItem.rank === 1 ? '🥇' : (rowItem.rank === 2 ? '🥈' : (rowItem.rank === 3 ? '🥉' : '🌟'));
        const fullCertTitle = `${rankEmoji} ${baseTitle} • מקום ${rowItem.rank} ${rankEmoji}`;

        let periodDesc = '';
        let dateStr = '';
        if (currentCertScoreboardDateMode === 'period') {
            const optSelect = document.getElementById('cert-sb-period-option');
            const val = optSelect?.value || '';
            const selectedText = optSelect?.options[optSelect.selectedIndex]?.text || '';
            const [sDate, eDate] = val.split('|');
            const dispStart = formatISOToDisplayDate(sDate);
            const dispEnd = formatISOToDisplayDate(eDate);
            periodDesc = `על הישגים מרשימים בטבלת הניקוד עבור: <b>${selectedText}</b>`;
            dateStr = dispStart && dispEnd ? `${dispStart} - ${dispEnd}` : formatISOToDisplayDate(getLocalISODateString(new Date()));
        } else {
            let startVal = document.getElementById('cert-sb-start-date')?.value || getSystemStartISODate();
            let endVal = document.getElementById('cert-sb-end-date')?.value || getLocalISODateString(new Date());
            if (startVal > endVal) { const tmp = startVal; startVal = endVal; endVal = tmp; }
            const dispStart = formatISOToDisplayDate(startVal);
            const dispEnd = formatISOToDisplayDate(endVal);
            periodDesc = `על הישגים מרשימים בטבלת הניקוד בתקופה: <b>${dispStart} – ${dispEnd}</b>`;
            dateStr = `${dispStart} - ${dispEnd}`;
        }

        const customFreeText = (document.getElementById('cert-sb-custom-text')?.value || '').trim();
        const customFreeHtml = customFreeText
            ? `<div style="margin-top:8px; font-size:14.5px; color:#03045e; font-style:italic;">"${customFreeText.replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')}"</div>`
            : '';

        const statsSummaryLine = `מקום <b>${rowItem.rank}</b> בטבלת הניקוד | <b>${rowItem.totalScore}</b> כוכבים ⭐ | <b>${rowItem.totalWins}</b> נצחונות 🏅 | <b>${rowItem.trophies}</b> גביעים 🏆${customFreeHtml}`;

        let entries = [];
        if (rowItem.isTeam) {
            const tObj = registeredTeams.find(t => t.name === rowItem.name);
            const members = tObj && Array.isArray(tObj.kidsIds)
                ? tObj.kidsIds.map(id => registeredKids.find(k => k.id === id)?.name || '').filter(Boolean)
                : [];
            const membersList = members.length > 0 ? members : [rowItem.name];
            membersList.forEach(memberName => {
                const kidRec = registeredKids.find(k => k.name === memberName);
                entries.push({
                    customTitle: fullCertTitle,
                    recipientName: memberName,
                    kidClass: kidRec ? formatClassDisplay(kidRec.classLetter, kidRec.classNum) : '',
                    avatar: kidRec ? kidRec.avatar : (tObj?.avatar || '👥'),
                    teamName: rowItem.name,
                    teamMembers: membersList,
                    periodDescHtml: periodDesc,
                    statsSummaryHtml: statsSummaryLine,
                    dateStr: dateStr,
                    isChampion: rowItem.rank === 1
                });
            });
        } else {
            const kidRec = registeredKids.find(k => k.name === rowItem.name);
            const clsStr = kidRec ? formatClassDisplay(kidRec.classLetter, kidRec.classNum) : (rowItem.className || 'ללא');
            entries.push({
                customTitle: fullCertTitle,
                recipientName: rowItem.name,
                kidClass: clsStr,
                avatar: kidRec ? kidRec.avatar : '👦',
                teamName: null,
                teamMembers: [],
                periodDescHtml: periodDesc,
                statsSummaryHtml: statsSummaryLine,
                dateStr: dateStr,
                isChampion: rowItem.rank === 1
            });
        }
        return entries;
    }

    function exportScoreboardCertByRowIndex(idx) {
        const row = lastFilteredScoreboardCertRows[idx];
        if (!row) return;
        const entries = buildScoreboardCertEntriesForRow(row);
        exportCertificatesListPDF(entries);
    }

    function exportTop3ScoreboardCertificatesPDF() {
        const top3 = (lastFilteredScoreboardCertRows || []).filter(
            it => it.rank <= 3 && (it.trophies > 0 || it.totalWins > 0 || it.totalScore > 0)
        );
        if (top3.length === 0) {
            alert("אין שחקנים בשלישייה הראשונה בתקופה שנבחרה.");
            return;
        }
        let allEntries = [];
        top3.forEach(row => {
            allEntries = allEntries.concat(buildScoreboardCertEntriesForRow(row));
        });
        exportCertificatesListPDF(allEntries);
    }

    function getValidatedCertIssuerName() {
        const inputEl = document.getElementById('cert-issuer-name-input');
        const val = inputEl ? inputEl.value.trim() : '';
        if (!val) {
            alert("⚠️ חובה למלא את שדה 'שם המורה או שם בית הספר' לפני הדפסת תעודת ההוקרה!");
            if (inputEl) inputEl.focus();
            return null;
        }
        return val;
    }

    function exportCertificatesListPDF(entries) {
        if (!entries || entries.length === 0) return;
        const issuerName = getValidatedCertIssuerName();
        if (!issuerName) return;

        const safeIssuerHtml = escapePdfHtml(issuerName);
        const issuerHeaderText = `${safeIssuerHtml} • English With Friends`;
        const exportContainer = document.getElementById('pdf-export-view');
        if (!exportContainer) return;
        let html = '';
        entries.forEach(c => {
            const titleLine = c.customTitle
                ? escapePdfHtml(c.customTitle)
                : (c.isChampion ? '🏆 תעודת הצטיינות ואליפות 🏆' : '🌟 תעודת הוקרה והשתתפות 🌟');
            const membersSafe = Array.isArray(c.teamMembers) ? c.teamMembers.map(m => escapePdfHtml(m)).join(', ') : '';
            const subLine = c.teamName
                ? `חבר/ה בקבוצת <b>"${escapePdfHtml(c.teamName)}"</b><br><span style="font-size:13px; color:#555;">חברי הקבוצה: ${membersSafe}</span>`
                : `כיתה: <b>${escapePdfHtml(c.kidClass || '-')}</b>`;

            const bodyDescHtml = c.periodDescHtml
                ? `${c.periodDescHtml}<br><div style="margin-top:8px; font-size:15.5px; color:#92400e;">${c.statsSummaryHtml || ''}</div>`
                : `על השתתפות מופתית, הפגנת ידע בשפה האנגלית, מהירות מחשבה ורוח ספורטיבית במסגרת:<br><b style="font-size: 18px; color: #92400e;">${escapePdfHtml(c.tournamentName || '')}</b>`;

            html += `
                <div class="cert-page">
                    <div style="font-size: 15px; color: #0077b6; font-weight: bold;">${issuerHeaderText}</div>
                    <h1 style="font-size: 28px; color: #92400e; margin: 16px 0 8px 0;">${titleLine}</h1>
                    <p style="font-size: 16px; color: #03045e;">תעודה זו מוענקת בגאווה רבה ל:</p>
                    <div style="font-size: 30px; font-weight: bold; color: #03045e; margin: 12px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #f59e0b; display: inline-block; padding: 4px 28px;">
                        ${escapePdfHtml(c.avatar || '🏅')} ${escapePdfHtml(c.recipientName || '')}
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size: 15px; color: #03045e; margin-bottom: 14px;">${subLine}</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 15px; color: #023e8a; line-height: 1.6;">
                        ${bodyDescHtml}
                    </div>
                    <div style="margin-top: 24px; display: flex; justify-content: space-around; font-size: 13px; color: #555;">
                        <div>תאריך: <b>${escapePdfHtml(c.dateStr || '')}</b></div>
                        <div>מוענק מטעם: <b>${safeIssuerHtml}</b></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        });
        triggerPrintExport(exportContainer, html);
    }

    /* =========================================================================
       6. מסך דוחות מערכת (לשוניות: broad, kids, teams, tournaments, certs)
       ========================================================================= */

    function switchReportSheet(sheet) {
        currentReportSheet = sheet;
        document.getElementById('rep-tab-broad').classList.toggle('active-tab', sheet === 'broad');
        document.getElementById('rep-tab-kids').classList.toggle('active-tab', sheet === 'kids');
        document.getElementById('rep-tab-teams').classList.toggle('active-tab', sheet === 'teams');
        document.getElementById('rep-tab-tournaments').classList.toggle('active-tab', sheet === 'tournaments');
        const certsTabBtn = document.getElementById('rep-tab-certs');
        if (certsTabBtn) certsTabBtn.classList.toggle('active-tab', sheet === 'certs');
        renderReportsContent();
    }

    function renderReportsContent() {
        const container = document.getElementById('reports-sheet-container');
        const searchBarsWrapper = document.getElementById('report-search-bars-wrapper');
        const certsSubpanel = document.getElementById('certs-subpanel-wrapper');

        if (currentReportSheet === 'certs') {
            if (searchBarsWrapper) searchBarsWrapper.style.display = 'none';
            if (container) container.style.display = 'none';
            if (certsSubpanel) certsSubpanel.style.display = 'flex';
            switchCertSubMode(currentCertSubMode || 'tournaments');
            return;
        } else {
            if (searchBarsWrapper) searchBarsWrapper.style.display = 'flex';
            if (container) container.style.display = 'block';
            if (certsSubpanel) certsSubpanel.style.display = 'none';
        }

        const nameSearch = document.getElementById('report-search-input').value.trim().toLowerCase();
        const descFilter = document.getElementById('report-desc-filter-input').value.trim().toLowerCase();

        const gameTitles = {
            sounds: '🎵 Sound Adventure • הרפתקת הצלילים',
            caseMatch: '🔠 Letter Match • התאמת אותיות',
            sequences: '🚂 Alphabet Train • רכבת הסדרות באלפבית',
            memory: '🧠 Memory Game • משחק הזיכרון'
        };

        let html = '';

        if (currentReportSheet === 'tournaments') {
    const allT = getAllRecordedTournaments()
        .filter(t => shouldIncludeTournamentInReports(t))
        .filter(t => {
            const tName = (t.name || '').toLowerCase();
            const partsText = (t.participants || []).map(p => `${p.name} ${(p.kidsMembersList || []).join(' ')}`).join(' ').toLowerCase();
            const descText = (t.participants || []).map(p => `${p.className || ''} ${p.classDesc || ''} ${p.subtitle || ''}`).join(' ').toLowerCase();
            const nameOk = !nameSearch || tName.includes(nameSearch) || partsText.includes(nameSearch);
            const descOk = !descFilter || descText.includes(descFilter) || descText.replace(/'/g, '').includes(descFilter.replace(/'/g, '')) || tName.includes(descFilter);
            return nameOk && descOk;
        });

    if (allT.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `<p style="font-size: 12px; color: #6c757d; text-align: center; padding: 15px;">אין טורנירים להצגה בדוח.</p>`;
        return;
    }

    allT.forEach(t => {
        const isMem = (t.mode === 'memory' || t.tournamentCategory === 'memory');
        const subTypeLabel = isMem ? getMemorySubModeLabel(t.subMode || t.gameType) : getTournamentGameDisplayInfo(t).headerGamesSummary;
        const statusBadge = isTournamentTrulyCompleted(t)
            ? (t.champion ? `👑 הסתיים • אלוף: ${formatParticipantLabelWithClass(t.champion)}` : '✅ הסתיים')
            : '⚡ פעיל • משחקים ששוחקו';
        const participantsChipsHtml = (t.participants || []).map(p => {
            let lbl = formatParticipantLabelWithClass(p);
            if (p.isTeam && Array.isArray(p.kidsMembersList) && p.kidsMembersList.length > 0) {
                lbl += ` [חברים: ${p.kidsMembersList.join(', ')}]`;
            }
            return `<span style="display:inline-block; background:white; border:1px solid #fcd34d; border-radius:8px; padding:2px 7px; margin:2px; font-size:11px; color:#03045e;">${lbl}</span>`;
        }).join('');

        html += `<div style="background:${isMem ? '#f5f3ff' : '#fffbeb'}; border:1.5px solid ${isMem ? '#8b5cf6' : '#f59e0b'}; border-radius:12px; padding:10px; margin-bottom:10px; text-align:right;">
            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
                <b style="color:${isMem ? '#5b21b6' : '#92400e'}; font-size:13.5px;">${isMem ? '🧠' : '🏆'} ${t.name} (${t.size} משתתפים)</b>
                <span style="font-size:11px; color:#555;">${t.completedAt || t.createdAt}</span>
            </div>
            <div style="font-size:11px; color:#03045e; margin-top:2px;">סוג: <b>${subTypeLabel}</b></div>
            <div style="font-size:11.5px; color:#03045e; margin-top:5px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.75); padding:6px 8px; border-radius:8px; border:1px dashed ${isMem ? '#8b5cf6' : '#f59e0b'};">
                <b>👥 רשימת השחקנים בטורניר (${(t.participants || []).length}):</b>
                <div style="margin-top:3px;">${participantsChipsHtml || 'אין שחקנים רשומים'}</div>
            </div>
            <div style="font-size:12px; color:#065f46; font-weight:bold; margin:6px 0 8px 0;">${statusBadge}</div>`;

        t.rounds.forEach((round, rIdx) => {
            html += `<div style="background:white; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:8px; padding:6px 8px; margin-bottom:6px;">
                <div style="font-size:11.5px; font-weight:bold; color:#03045e; margin-bottom:4px;">${round.roundName}</div>`;
            round.matches.forEach((m, mIdx) => {
                const p1Label = m.p1 ? formatParticipantLabelWithClass(m.p1) : 'ממתין';
                const p2Label = m.p2 ? formatParticipantLabelWithClass(m.p2) : 'ממתין';
                const debriefBtn = `<button type="button" onclick="openMatchDebrief('${t.id}', ${rIdx}, ${mIdx})" style="background:#0077b6; color:white; border:none; border-radius:6px; padding:3px 8px; font-size:10.5px; cursor:pointer;">📊 נתוני משחק</button>`;
                if (m.isMemorySingleTime) {
                    if (m.status === 'completed') {
                        html += `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; font-size:11.5px; padding:4px 0; border-top:1px dashed #e2e8f0; gap:6px;">
                            <span>${p1Label} • ⏱️ <b>${m.p1Score}</b></span>
                            ${debriefBtn}
                        </div>`;
                    } else {
                        html += `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; font-size:11px; color:#64748b; padding:3px 0; border-top:1px dashed #e2e8f0;">
                            <span>${p1Label}</span>
                            <span>⏳ טרם הושלם</span>
                        </div>`;
                    }
                } else if (m.status === 'completed') {
                    html += `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; font-size:11.5px; padding:4px 0; border-top:1px dashed #e2e8f0; gap:6px;">
                        <span>${p1Label} (${m.p1Score}) <b>VS</b> ${p2Label} (${m.p2Score}) • 🏆 <b>${m.winner?.name}</b></span>
                        ${debriefBtn}
                    </div>`;
                } else {
                    html += `<div style="font-size:11px; color:#64748b; padding:3px 0; border-top:1px dashed #e2e8f0;">${p1Label} VS ${p2Label}</div>`;
                }
            });
            html += `</div>`;
        });
        html += `</div>`;
    });
    container.innerHTML = html;
    return;
}

        let hasAnyMatch = false;

        for (let gKey in globalGameHistory) {
            let historyArr = globalGameHistory[gKey] || [];
            historyArr.forEach((sess, sIdx) => {
                let filteredSnapshot = (sess.playersSnapshot || []).filter(pl => {
                    let isTeamMatch = pl.isTeam || pl.type === 'team';
                    if (currentReportSheet === 'kids' && isTeamMatch) return false;
                    if (currentReportSheet === 'teams' && !isTeamMatch) return false;

                    let plName = (pl.name || '').toLowerCase();
                    let regKid = !isTeamMatch ? registeredKids.find(k => k.id === pl.id || k.name === pl.name) : null;
                    let regTeam = isTeamMatch ? registeredTeams.find(t => t.id === pl.id || t.name === pl.name) : null;
                    let regClassStr = regKid ? formatClassDisplay(regKid.classLetter, regKid.classNum).toLowerCase() : '';
                    let regTeamDesc = regTeam ? (regTeam.classDesc || '').toLowerCase() : '';
                    let plClass = ((pl.className || '') + ' ' + (pl.classDesc || '') + ' ' + regClassStr + ' ' + regTeamDesc).toLowerCase();
                    let plClassNormalized = plClass.replace(/'/g, '');
                    let descFilterNormalized = descFilter.replace(/'/g, '');

                    let tournStr = (sess.tournamentName || '').toLowerCase();
                    let kidsStr = isTeamMatch && pl.kidsMembersList ? pl.kidsMembersList.join(' ').toLowerCase() : '';
                    let nameMatch = !nameSearch || plName.includes(nameSearch) || kidsStr.includes(nameSearch) || tournStr.includes(nameSearch);
                    let descMatch = !descFilter || plClass.includes(descFilter) || plClassNormalized.includes(descFilterNormalized) || tournStr.includes(descFilter);
                    return nameMatch && descMatch;
                });

                if (filteredSnapshot.length > 0) {
                    hasAnyMatch = true;
                    const modeTag = sess.tournamentName
                        ? `<span style="background:#fef3c7; color:#92400e; padding:1px 6px; border-radius:6px;">🏆 טורניר: ${sess.tournamentName}</span>`
                        : `<span style="background:#e0fbfc; color:#0077b6; padding:1px 6px; border-radius:6px;">🎮 משחק רגיל</span>`;

                    html += `<div style="margin-bottom: 10px; border: 1px solid #90e0ef; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px; background: #ffffff;">`;
                    html += `<div style="font-weight: bold; color: #0077b6; font-size: 11.5px; margin-bottom: 4px;">${modeTag} | ${gameTitles[gKey] || gKey} | סבב #${sIdx + 1} (${sess.date}) | מנצח: ${sess.winnersNames}</div>`;

                    filteredSnapshot.forEach(pl => {
                        let isTeamItem = pl.isTeam || pl.type === 'team';
                        let kidsDetailStr = (isTeamItem && pl.kidsMembersList) ? `<br><span style="font-size:10.5px; color:#444;">חברי הקבוצה: ${pl.kidsMembersList.join(', ')}</span>` : '';
                        let plHeaderLabel = isTeamItem ? `${pl.avatar} ${pl.name}` : `${pl.avatar} ${pl.name}${getKidClassBadge(pl)}`;
                        html += `<div style="background: #f4fbfd; border: 1px solid #ced4da; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px; margin-top: 4px;">`;
                        html += `<div style="font-weight: bold; color: #03045e; font-size: 11.5px;">${plHeaderLabel}</div>${kidsDetailStr}`;

                        if (gKey === 'memory' && (typeof pl.pairsFound === 'number' || typeof pl.attempts === 'number' || typeof pl.elapsedSeconds === 'number')) {
                            const memMetaParts = [];
                            if (typeof pl.pairsFound === 'number') memMetaParts.push(`זוגות שהותאמו: <b>${pl.pairsFound}</b>`);
                            if (typeof pl.attempts === 'number') memMetaParts.push(`ניסיונות: <b>${pl.attempts}</b>`);
                            if (typeof pl.elapsedSeconds === 'number') {
                                const tLbl = pl.formattedTime || (typeof formatSecondsReadable === 'function' ? formatSecondsReadable(pl.elapsedSeconds) : `${pl.elapsedSeconds} שנ'`);
                                memMetaParts.push(`⏱️ זמן: <b>${tLbl}</b>`);
                            }
                            if (memMetaParts.length > 0) {
                                html += `<div style="font-size:10.5px; color:#0369a1; margin-top:2px;">${memMetaParts.join(' • ')}</div>`;
                            }
                        }
                        if (pl.sessionLogs && pl.sessionLogs.length > 0) {
