                        <div style="flex: 1; line-height: 1.35;">
                            <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #03045e; direction: ltr; text-align: right;">${line.en}</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; color: #0284c7;">${line.translit}</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 12px; color: #475569;">${line.he}</div>
                        </div>
                        <button type="button" class="lyric-speak-btn" onclick="speakEnglishPhrase('${line.en.replace(/'/g, "\'")}', ${idx})" title="השמע שורה באנגלית">🔊</button>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
        }
    }

    function playCurrentSongVideo(slowMode = false) {
        const vid = document.getElementById('song-video-player');
        if (!vid) return;
        vid.playbackRate = slowMode ? 0.75 : 1.0;
        vid.play().catch(() => {});
    }

    function initSongVideoSync() {
        if (songSyncInitialized) return;
        const vid = document.getElementById('song-video-player');
        if (!vid) return;
        songSyncInitialized = true;

        vid.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => {
            const song = LEARNING_SONGS_DB.find(s => s.id === currentSelectedSongId);
            if (!song) return;
            const t = vid.currentTime;
            song.lyrics.forEach((line, idx) => {
                const row = document.getElementById('lyric-row-' + idx);
                if (!row) return;
                if (!vid.paused && t >= line.startSec && t < line.endSec) {
                    row.classList.add('active-lyric');
                } else {
                    row.classList.remove('active-lyric');
                }
            });
        });

        vid.addEventListener('ended', () => {
            document.querySelectorAll('.lyric-line-row').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active-lyric'));
        });
    }

    function speakEnglishPhrase(phrase, lineIdx = null) {
        if (!('speechSynthesis' in window) || !phrase) return;
        const vid = document.getElementById('song-video-player');
        if (vid && !vid.paused) vid.pause();

        document.querySelectorAll('.lyric-line-row').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active-lyric'));
        if (lineIdx !== null) {
            const row = document.getElementById('lyric-row-' + lineIdx);
            if (row) row.classList.add('active-lyric');
        }

        try {
            window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
            const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(phrase);
            u.lang = 'en-US';
            u.rate = 0.85;
            u.pitch = 1.05;
            const enVoice = getPreferredEnglishVoice();
            if (enVoice) u.voice = enVoice;
            u.onend = () => {
                if (lineIdx !== null) {
                    const row = document.getElementById('lyric-row-' + lineIdx);
                    if (row) row.classList.remove('active-lyric');
                }
            };
            window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    function speakFullSongLyrics() {
        const song = LEARNING_SONGS_DB.find(s => s.id === currentSelectedSongId) || LEARNING_SONGS_DB[0];
        const fullText = song.lyrics.map(l => l.en).join(' ');
        speakEnglishPhrase(fullText, null);
    }
</script>


<script>
    /* =========================================================================
       🧠 מנוע משחק הזיכרון וטורניר הזיכרון הנפרד (כולל המשכיות, איפוס והשהיית דו-קרב)
       ========================================================================= */

    const MEMORY_DIFFICULTY = {
        1: { pairs: 4,  cols: 4, rows: 2, label: "רמה 1 - מתחילים (4 זוגות • 8 קלפים)" },
        2: { pairs: 6,  cols: 4, rows: 3, label: "רמה 2 - קל (6 זוגות • 12 קלפים)" },
        3: { pairs: 8,  cols: 4, rows: 4, label: "רמה 3 - בינוני (8 זוגות • 16 קלפים)" },
        4: { pairs: 10, cols: 4, rows: 5, label: "רמה 4 - מתקדם (10 זוגות • 20 קלפים)" },
        5: { pairs: 12, cols: 4, rows: 6, label: "רמה 5 - אלופים (12 זוגות • 24 קלפים)" }
    };

    const MEMORY_MODES = {
        FREE_SINGLE: 'free_single',
        FREE_PAIRS: 'free_pairs',
        TOURNEY_SINGLE_TIME: 'tourney_single_time',
        TOURNEY_PAIRS_WINNER: 'tourney_pairs_winner'
    };

    const MEMORY_ALPHABET_PAIRS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".split("").map(ch => ({
        letter: ch,
        upper: ch,
        lower: ch.toLowerCase()
    }));

    class MemoryGameController {
        constructor(options) {
            this.mode = options.mode;
            this.level = options.level || 2;
            this.pairsCount = MEMORY_DIFFICULTY[this.level].pairs;
            this.is180Split = options.is180Split || false;
            this.tournamentId = options.tournamentId || null;
            this.matchId = options.matchId || null;
            this.savedState = options.savedState || null;

            this.players = options.players.map(p => ({
                id: p.id,
                name: p.name,
                gradeOrDesc: p.gradeOrDesc || p.classDesc || p.className || '',
                avatar: p.avatar || '🦁',
                pairsFound: 0,
                attempts: 0
            }));

            this.cards = [];
            this.flippedCards = [];
            this.matchedPairsTotal = 0;
            this.currentPlayerIndex = 0;
            this.isLocked = false;

            this.hasTimer = (typeof options.hasTimer === 'boolean')
                ? options.hasTimer
                : (this.mode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_SINGLE_TIME || this.mode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_PAIRS_WINNER);
            this.elapsedSeconds = 0;
            this.timerInterval = null;
            this.startTime = null;

            this.moveHistory = [];
            this.onRender = options.onRender;
            this.onComplete = options.onComplete;
        }

        start() {
            if (this.savedState && Array.isArray(this.savedState.cards) && this.savedState.cards.length > 0) {
                // שחזור מדויק של משחק שנעצר באמצע
                this.cards = this.savedState.cards.map(c => ({
                    ...c,
                    isFlipped: !!c.isMatched // קלפים שלא הותאמו חוזרים מוסתרים
                }));
                this.flippedCards = [];
                this.matchedPairsTotal = this.savedState.matchedPairsTotal || 0;
                this.currentPlayerIndex = this.savedState.currentPlayerIndex || 0;
                this.elapsedSeconds = this.savedState.elapsedSeconds || 0;
                this.moveHistory = Array.isArray(this.savedState.moveHistory) ? [...this.savedState.moveHistory] : [];
                if (Array.isArray(this.savedState.players)) {
                    this.players = this.savedState.players.map(p => ({ ...p }));
                }
            } else {
                const chosenPairs = [...MEMORY_ALPHABET_PAIRS]
                    .sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5)
                    .slice(0, this.pairsCount);

                const deck = [];
                chosenPairs.forEach((item, idx) => {
                    deck.push({
                        uid: `c_${idx}_upper`,
                        pairId: idx,
                        caseType: 'upper',
                        mainText: item.upper,
                        subText: 'אות גדולה',
                        isFlipped: false,
                        isMatched: false
                    });
                    deck.push({
                        uid: `c_${idx}_lower`,
                        pairId: idx,
                        caseType: 'lower',
                        mainText: item.lower,
                        subText: 'אות קטנה',
                        isFlipped: false,
                        isMatched: false
                    });
                });

                this.cards = deck.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
            }

            if (this.hasTimer) {
                this.startTimer();
            }

            this.persistActiveState();
            this.triggerRender();
        }

        startTimer() {
            this.startTime = Date.now() - (this.elapsedSeconds * 1000);
            this.timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
                this.elapsedSeconds = Math.floor((Date.now() - this.startTime) / 1000);
                this.triggerRender();
            }, 1000);
        }

        stopTimer() {
            if (this.timerInterval) {
                clearInterval(this.timerInterval);
                this.timerInterval = null;
            }
        }

        handleCardClick(cardUid) {
            if (this.isLocked) return;

            const card = this.cards.find(c => c.uid === cardUid);
            if (!card || card.isFlipped || card.isMatched) return;

            card.isFlipped = true;
            this.flippedCards.push(card);
            this.triggerRender();

            if (this.flippedCards.length === 2) {
                this.evaluateTurn();
            }
        }

        evaluateTurn() {
            this.isLocked = true;
            const [firstCard, secondCard] = this.flippedCards;
            const activePlayer = this.players[this.currentPlayerIndex];
            activePlayer.attempts += 1;

            const isMatch = (firstCard.pairId === secondCard.pairId);

            this.moveHistory.push({
                playerId: activePlayer.id,
                playerName: activePlayer.name,
                card1: firstCard.mainText,
                card2: secondCard.mainText,
                isMatch,
                timeAtMove: this.hasTimer ? this.elapsedSeconds : null
            });

            if (isMatch) {
                if (typeof playSuccessSound === 'function') playSuccessSound();
                setTimeout(() => {
                    firstCard.isMatched = true;
                    secondCard.isMatched = true;
                    activePlayer.pairsFound += 1;
                    this.matchedPairsTotal += 1;
                    this.flippedCards = [];
                    this.isLocked = false;

                    this.persistActiveState();
                    this.triggerRender();

                    if (this.matchedPairsTotal === this.pairsCount) {
                        this.finishGame();
                    }
                }, 450);
            } else {
                if (typeof playErrorSound === 'function') playErrorSound();
                setTimeout(() => {
                    firstCard.isFlipped = false;
                    secondCard.isFlipped = false;
                    this.flippedCards = [];

                    if (this.isPairsMode()) {
                        this.currentPlayerIndex = (this.currentPlayerIndex + 1) % this.players.length;
                    }

                    this.isLocked = false;
                    this.persistActiveState();
                    this.triggerRender();
                }, 1100);
            }
        }

        isPairsMode() {
            return this.mode === MEMORY_MODES.FREE_PAIRS || this.mode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_PAIRS_WINNER;
        }

        isTournamentMode() {
            return this.mode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_SINGLE_TIME || this.mode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_PAIRS_WINNER;
        }

        getSerializableSnapshot() {
            return {
                tournamentId: this.tournamentId,
                matchId: this.matchId,
                mode: this.mode,
                level: this.level,
                is180Split: this.is180Split,
                players: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.players)),
                cards: this.cards.map(c => ({
                    ...c,
                    isFlipped: !!c.isMatched
                })),
                matchedPairsTotal: this.matchedPairsTotal,
                currentPlayerIndex: this.currentPlayerIndex,
                elapsedSeconds: this.elapsedSeconds,
                moveHistory: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.moveHistory))
            };
        }

        persistActiveState() {
            if (!this.isTournamentMode()) return;
            const snapshot = this.getSerializableSnapshot();
            localStorage.setItem('ewf_active_memory_match', JSON.stringify(snapshot));

            if (typeof memoryTourneyManager !== 'undefined' && this.tournamentId && this.matchId) {
                memoryTourneyManager.saveMatchProgress(this.tournamentId, this.matchId, snapshot);
            }
        }

        clearActiveState() {
            localStorage.removeItem('ewf_active_memory_match');
            if (typeof memoryTourneyManager !== 'undefined' && this.tournamentId && this.matchId) {
                memoryTourneyManager.clearMatchProgress(this.tournamentId, this.matchId);
            }
        }

        finishGame() {
            this.stopTimer();
            this.clearActiveState();

            let winner = null;
            let countsForGlobalScore = false;

            switch (this.mode) {
                case MEMORY_MODES.FREE_SINGLE:
                    winner = this.players[0];
                    countsForGlobalScore = false;
                    break;
                case MEMORY_MODES.FREE_PAIRS:
                    winner = [...this.players].sort((a, b) => b.pairsFound - a.pairsFound)[0];
                    countsForGlobalScore = true;
                    break;
                case MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_SINGLE_TIME:
                    winner = this.players[0];
                    countsForGlobalScore = true;
                    break;
                case MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_PAIRS_WINNER:
                    winner = [...this.players].sort((a, b) => b.pairsFound - a.pairsFound)[0];
                    countsForGlobalScore = true;
                    break;
            }

            const summary = {
                mode: this.mode,
                isTournament: this.isTournamentMode(),
                tournamentId: this.tournamentId,
                matchId: this.matchId,
                level: this.level,
                winner,
                players: this.players,
                elapsedSeconds: this.hasTimer ? this.elapsedSeconds : null,
                countsForGlobalScore,
                moveHistory: this.moveHistory,
                completedAt: new Date().toISOString()
            };

            if (this.onComplete) {
                this.onComplete(summary);
            }
        }

        triggerRender() {
            if (this.onRender) {
                this.onRender({
                    mode: this.mode,
                    hasTimer: this.hasTimer,
                    elapsedSeconds: this.elapsedSeconds,
                    is180Split: this.is180Split,
                    players: this.players,
                    currentPlayerIndex: this.currentPlayerIndex,
                    cards: this.cards,
                    isLocked: this.isLocked,
                    matchedPairsTotal: this.matchedPairsTotal,
                    totalPairs: this.pairsCount,
                    level: this.level
                });
            }
        }
    }

    class MemoryTournamentSystem {
        constructor() {
            this.STORAGE_KEY = 'ewf_memory_tournaments';
            this.tournaments = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(this.STORAGE_KEY) || '[]');
        }

        save() {
            localStorage.setItem(this.STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.tournaments));
        }

        saveMatchProgress(tournamentId, matchId, snapshot) {
            const tourney = this.tournaments.find(t => t.id === tournamentId);
            if (!tourney) return;
            const match = tourney.matches.find(m => m.matchId === matchId);
            if (!match || match.status === 'הסתיים') return;
            match.status = 'פעיל';
            match.savedGameState = snapshot;
            this.save();
        }

        clearMatchProgress(tournamentId, matchId) {
            const tourney = this.tournaments.find(t => t.id === tournamentId);
            if (!tourney) return;
            const match = tourney.matches.find(m => m.matchId === matchId);
            if (!match) return;
            delete match.savedGameState;
            this.save();
        }

        resetMatch(tournamentId, matchId) {
            const tourney = this.tournaments.find(t => t.id === tournamentId);
            if (!tourney) return;
            const match = tourney.matches.find(m => m.matchId === matchId);
            if (!match) return;

            delete match.savedGameState;
            localStorage.removeItem('ewf_active_memory_match');

            if (tourney.subMode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_SINGLE_TIME) {
                match.status = 'זמין';
                match.timeSeconds = null;
                match.attempts = 0;
            } else {
                const hasBothPlayers = !!(match.players && match.players[0] && match.players[1]);
                match.status = hasBothPlayers ? 'זמין' : 'ממתין';
                match.winnerId = null;
                match.pairScores = {};

                // איפוס שלבי המשך בעץ הנוקאאוט שהושפעו ממשחק זה
                if (typeof match.roundIdx === 'number' && typeof match.matchIndexInRound === 'number') {
                    let curR = match.roundIdx;
                    let curM = match.matchIndexInRound;
                    while (true) {
                        const nextR = curR + 1;
                        const nextM = Math.floor(curM / 2);
                        const slotIdx = curM % 2;
                        const nextMatch = tourney.matches.find(m => m.roundIdx === nextR && m.matchIndexInRound === nextM);
                        if (!nextMatch) break;
                        nextMatch.players[slotIdx] = null;
                        nextMatch.status = 'ממתין';
                        nextMatch.winnerId = null;
                        nextMatch.pairScores = {};
                        delete nextMatch.savedGameState;
                        curR = nextR;
                        curM = nextM;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (tourney.status === 'הסתיים') {
                tourney.status = 'פעיל';
                tourney.champion = null;
            }

            this.save();
        }

        createMemoryTournament({ name = "טורניר הזיכרון", password = "1234", subMode, level, is180Split = false, selectedPlayers }) {
            const countSameName = this.tournaments.filter(t => t.name.startsWith(name)).length;
            const formattedName = `${name} #${countSameName + 1}`;

            const matches = [];
            const baseTs = Date.now();

            if (subMode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_SINGLE_TIME) {
                selectedPlayers.forEach((player, index) => {
                    matches.push({
                        matchId: `m_single_${baseTs}_${index}`,
                        roundIdx: 0,
                        roundName: '⏱️ מקצי דירוג נגד השעון',
                        players: [player],
                        status: 'זמין',
                        timeSeconds: null,
                        attempts: 0
                    });
                });
            } else if (subMode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_PAIRS_WINNER) {
                const shuffled = [...selectedPlayers].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
                const totalSize = shuffled.length;
                const totalRounds = Math.log2(totalSize);

                const r0Name = typeof getRoundName === 'function' ? getRoundName(totalSize, 0) : 'סיבוב 1';
                for (let i = 0; i < totalSize; i += 2) {
                    matches.push({
                        matchId: `m_pair_${baseTs}_0_${i / 2}`,
                        roundIdx: 0,
                        matchIndexInRound: i / 2,
                        roundName: r0Name,
                        players: [shuffled[i], shuffled[i + 1]],
                        status: 'זמין',
                        winnerId: null,
                        pairScores: {}
                    });
                }

                let currentSize = totalSize / 2;
                for (let r = 1; r < totalRounds; r++) {
                    const rName = typeof getRoundName === 'function' ? getRoundName(currentSize, r) : `סיבוב ${r + 1}`;
                    for (let mIdx = 0; mIdx < currentSize / 2; mIdx++) {
                        matches.push({
                            matchId: `m_pair_${baseTs}_${r}_${mIdx}`,
                            roundIdx: r,
                            matchIndexInRound: mIdx,
                            roundName: rName,
                            players: [null, null],
                            status: 'ממתין',
                            winnerId: null,
                            pairScores: {}
                        });
                    }
                    currentSize /= 2;
                }
            }

            const tournament = {
                id: `mem_tourney_${baseTs}`,
                category: 'memory_only',
                name: formattedName,
                password: password || '1234',
                subMode,
                level,
                size: selectedPlayers.length,
                participants: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(selectedPlayers)),
                is180Split: subMode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_PAIRS_WINNER ? is180Split : false,
                status: 'פעיל',
                champion: null,
                createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                matches
            };

            this.tournaments.push(tournament);
            this.save();
            return tournament;
        }

        handleGameCompletion(summary) {
            const durationSec = typeof summary.elapsedSeconds === 'number' ? summary.elapsedSeconds : null;
            const detailedLogs = (summary.moveHistory || []).map((mv, idx) => ({
                moveNum: idx + 1,
                playerId: mv.playerId,
                playerName: mv.playerName,
                card1: mv.card1,
                card2: mv.card2,
                isMatch: !!mv.isMatch,
                timeAtMove: typeof mv.timeAtMove === 'number' ? mv.timeAtMove : null
            }));

            // 1. תיעוד משחקי זיכרון חופשיים (יחיד / דו-קרב) בהיסטוריית המערכת
            if (!summary.isTournament) {
                if (!Array.isArray(globalGameHistory.memory)) globalGameHistory.memory = [];
                const nowIso = typeof getLocalISODateString === 'function' ? getLocalISODateString(new Date()) : new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
                const timeStr = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('he-IL', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
                const isSingle = (summary.mode === MEMORY_MODES.FREE_SINGLE);
                const formattedDur = durationSec !== null && typeof formatSecondsReadable === 'function' ? formatSecondsReadable(durationSec) : null;

                const playersSnapshot = (summary.players || []).map(p => {
                    const pMoves = detailedLogs.filter(l => l.playerId === p.id);
                    const isTeamItem = !!p.isTeam;
                    let resolvedClassName = p.className || p.gradeOrDesc || '';
                    let resolvedClassDesc = p.classDesc || (isTeamItem ? (p.gradeOrDesc || '') : '');
                    let kidsMembersList = Array.isArray(p.kidsMembersList) ? p.kidsMembersList : undefined;

                    if (isTeamItem && typeof registeredTeams !== 'undefined' && typeof registeredKids !== 'undefined') {
                        const regT = registeredTeams.find(t => t.id === p.id || t.name === p.name);
                        if (regT) {
                            resolvedClassDesc = regT.classDesc || resolvedClassDesc;
                            kidsMembersList = (regT.kidsIds || [])
                                .map(kidId => registeredKids.find(k => k.id === kidId)?.name || '')
                                .filter(Boolean);
                        }
                    } else if (!isTeamItem && typeof registeredKids !== 'undefined' && typeof formatClassDisplay === 'function') {
                        const regK = registeredKids.find(k => k.id === p.id || k.name === p.name);
                        if (regK) {
                            resolvedClassName = formatClassDisplay(regK.classLetter, regK.classNum);
                        }
                    }

                    return {
                        id: p.id,
                        name: p.name,
                        className: resolvedClassName,
                        classDesc: resolvedClassDesc,
                        kidsMembersList,
                        isTeam: isTeamItem,
                        avatar: p.avatar || '🦁',
                        type: isTeamItem ? 'team' : 'kid',
                        scores: [p.pairsFound * 10, 0, 0],
                        pairsFound: p.pairsFound,
                        attempts: p.attempts,
                        elapsedSeconds: durationSec,
                        formattedTime: formattedDur,
                        sessionLogs: pMoves.map(m => ({
                            level: summary.level,
                            target: `${m.card1} ↔ ${m.card2}`,
                            hint: m.timeAtMove !== null ? `שנייה ${m.timeAtMove}` : 'מהלך זיכרון',
                            correctAnswer: m.card1.toUpperCase(),
                            chosen: m.card2,
                            correct: m.isMatch
                        }))
                    };
                });

                globalGameHistory.memory.push({
                    date: timeStr,
                    isoDate: nowIso,
                    modeLabel: isSingle ? 'משחק זיכרון • יחיד' : 'משחק זיכרון • דו-קרב',
                    elapsedSeconds: durationSec,
                    formattedTime: formattedDur,
                    playersSnapshot,
                    winnersNames: summary.winner ? summary.winner.name : (summary.players[0]?.name || ''),
                    memoryLogs: detailedLogs
                });
                if (typeof saveToLocalStorage === 'function') saveToLocalStorage();
                return;
            }

            // 2. תיעוד מקצי טורניר זיכרון (יחיד נגד השעון + דו-קרב)
            if (summary.isTournament && summary.tournamentId) {
                const tourney = this.tournaments.find(t => t.id === summary.tournamentId);
                if (!tourney) return;

                const match = tourney.matches.find(m => m.matchId === summary.matchId);
                if (!match) return;

                const formattedDur = formatSecondsReadable(durationSec);
match.status = 'הסתיים';
match.completedAt = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('he-IL', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
match.elapsedSeconds = durationSec;
match.formattedTime = formattedDur;
match.memoryLogs = detailedLogs;
delete match.savedGameState;

if (tourney.subMode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_SINGLE_TIME) {
    const p0 = summary.players[0];
    match.timeSeconds = durationSec;
    match.attempts = p0.attempts;
    match.pairsFound = p0.pairsFound;
    match.totalPairs = MEMORY_DIFFICULTY[tourney.level]?.pairs || p0.pairsFound;
    match.winnerId = p0.id;
    if (!Array.isArray(match.playerTimes)) match.playerTimes = [];
    const existingIdx = match.playerTimes.findIndex(pt => pt.playerId === p0.id);
    const timeEntry = {
        playerId: p0.id,
        playerName: p0.name,
        avatar: p0.avatar || '🦁',
        timeSeconds: durationSec,
        formattedTime: formattedDur,
        attempts: p0.attempts,
        pairsFound: p0.pairsFound
    };
    if (existingIdx >= 0) {
        match.playerTimes[existingIdx] = timeEntry;
    } else {
        match.playerTimes.push(timeEntry);
    }
    match.playerTimes.sort((a, b) => (a.timeSeconds ?? Infinity) - (b.timeSeconds ?? Infinity));
    if (!Array.isArray(globalGameHistory.memory)) globalGameHistory.memory = [];
    const nowIso = typeof getLocalISODateString === 'function' ? getLocalISODateString(new Date()) : new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    globalGameHistory.memory.push({
        date: match.completedAt,
        isoDate: nowIso,
        tournamentName: tourney.name,
        modeLabel: 'טורניר זיכרון • נגד השעון',
        timeSeconds: durationSec,
        elapsedSeconds: durationSec,
        formattedTime: formattedDur,
        playersSnapshot: [{
            id: p0.id,
            name: p0.name,
            avatar: p0.avatar || '🦁',
            scores: [p0.pairsFound * 10, 0, 0],
            pairsFound: p0.pairsFound,
            attempts: p0.attempts,
            timeSeconds: durationSec,
            elapsedSeconds: durationSec,
            formattedTime: formattedDur
        }],
        winnersNames: p0.name,
        memoryLogs: detailedLogs
    });
    if (typeof saveToLocalStorage === 'function') saveToLocalStorage();
} else {
                    match.winnerId = summary.winner.id;
                    match.pairScores = summary.players.reduce((acc, p) => {
                        acc[p.id] = p.pairsFound;
                        return acc;
                    }, {});
                    match.attemptCounts = summary.players.reduce((acc, p) => {
                        acc[p.id] = p.attempts;
                        return acc;
                    }, {});

                    const winnerObj = match.players.find(p => p && p.id === summary.winner.id) || summary.winner;

                    if (typeof match.roundIdx === 'number' && typeof match.matchIndexInRound === 'number') {
                        const nextRoundIdx = match.roundIdx + 1;
                        const nextMatchIdx = Math.floor(match.matchIndexInRound / 2);
                        const slotIdx = match.matchIndexInRound % 2;
                        const nextMatch = tourney.matches.find(m => m.roundIdx === nextRoundIdx && m.matchIndexInRound === nextMatchIdx);
                        if (nextMatch) {
                            nextMatch.players[slotIdx] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(winnerObj));
                            if (nextMatch.players[0] && nextMatch.players[1]) {
                                nextMatch.status = 'זמין';
                            }
                        } else {
                            tourney.champion = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(winnerObj));
                        }
                    }

                    const isFinalMatch = !tourney.matches.some(m => (m.roundIdx || 0) > (match.roundIdx || 0));
                    this.safelyUpdateGlobalProfileStats(winnerObj, {
                        trophiesToAdd: isFinalMatch ? 1 : 0,
                        winsToAdd: 1,
                        scoreToAdd: summary.winner.pairsFound * 10
                    });
                }

                if (tourney.matches.every(m => m.status === 'הסתיים')) {
                    tourney.status = 'הסתיים';
                    tourney.completedAt = new Date().toLocaleDateString('he-IL') + ' ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('he-IL', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

                    if (tourney.subMode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_SINGLE_TIME) {
                        const fastestMatch = [...tourney.matches].sort((a, b) => a.timeSeconds - b.timeSeconds)[0];
                        if (fastestMatch) {
                            tourney.champion = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(fastestMatch.players[0]));
                            this.safelyUpdateGlobalProfileStats(fastestMatch.players[0], {
                                trophiesToAdd: 1,
                                winsToAdd: 1,
                                scoreToAdd: 100
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }

                this.save();
            }
        }

        getTournamentStandings(tournamentId) {
            const tourney = this.tournaments.find(t => t.id === tournamentId);
            if (!tourney) return [];

            if (tourney.subMode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_SINGLE_TIME) {
                return tourney.matches
                    .filter(m => m.status === 'הסתיים')
                    .map(m => ({
                        player: m.players[0],
                        metricDisplay: `${m.timeSeconds} שניות`,
                        rawValue: m.timeSeconds,
                        attempts: m.attempts
                    }))
                    .sort((a, b) => a.rawValue - b.rawValue);
            } else {
                return tourney.matches
                    .filter(m => m.status === 'הסתיים')
                    .map(m => {
                        const winnerObj = m.players.find(p => p.id === m.winnerId);
                        return {
                            player: winnerObj,
                            metricDisplay: `${m.pairScores[m.winnerId]} זוגות`,
                            rawValue: m.pairScores[m.winnerId]
                        };
                    })
                    .sort((a, b) => b.rawValue - a.rawValue);
            }
        }

        safelyUpdateGlobalProfileStats(playerObj, { trophiesToAdd = 0, winsToAdd = 0, scoreToAdd = 0 }) {
            try {
                const playerId = typeof playerObj === 'object' ? playerObj.id : playerObj;
                const profilesKey = 'ewf_profiles';
                const profiles = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(profilesKey) || '[]');
                let player = profiles.find(p => p.id === playerId);
                if (!player && typeof playerObj === 'object') {
                    player = {
                        id: playerObj.id,
                        name: playerObj.name,
                        isTeam: !!playerObj.isTeam,
                        classDesc: playerObj.classDesc || '',
                        className: playerObj.className || '',
                        trophies: 0,
                        wins: 0,
                        totalScore: 0
                    };
                    profiles.push(player);
                }
                if (player) {
                    player.trophies = (player.trophies || 0) + trophiesToAdd;
                    player.wins = (player.wins || 0) + winsToAdd;
                    player.totalScore = (player.totalScore || 0) + scoreToAdd;
                    localStorage.setItem(profilesKey, JSON.stringify(profiles));
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("שגיאה בעדכון פרופיל גלובלי:", e);
            }
        }
    }

    const memoryTourneyManager = new MemoryTournamentSystem();
    let activeMemoryController = null;
    let selectedFreeMemoryMode = MEMORY_MODES.FREE_SINGLE;
    let selectedFreeMemoryPlayerIds = [];
    let memoryEndReturnToTournament = false;

    /* =========================================================================
       חיבור UI למשחק הזיכרון החופשי (יחיד / זוגות / 180 מעלות)
       ========================================================================= */

    let selectedFreeMemoryTimedMode = false;
    let selectedFreeMemoryLevel = 2;

    function selectFreeMemoryTimedMode(isTimed) {
        selectedFreeMemoryTimedMode = !!isTimed;
        const btnOff = document.getElementById('mem-timer-btn-off');
        const btnOn = document.getElementById('mem-timer-btn-on');
        if (btnOff) btnOff.classList.toggle('active-mode', !selectedFreeMemoryTimedMode);
        if (btnOn) btnOn.classList.toggle('active-mode', selectedFreeMemoryTimedMode);
        updateFreeMemoryRuleNote();
    }

    function selectFreeMemoryDifficulty(lvl) {
        selectedFreeMemoryLevel = lvl;
        for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
            const btn = document.getElementById(`mem-diff-btn-${i}`);
            if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active-mode', i === lvl);
        }
    }

    function updateFreeMemoryRuleNote() {
        const noteEl = document.getElementById('mem-mode-rule-note');
        if (!noteEl) return;
        const isPairs = (selectedFreeMemoryMode === MEMORY_MODES.FREE_PAIRS);
        const timerTxt = selectedFreeMemoryTimedMode ? 'עם שעון רץ (נגד הזמן)' : 'ללא שעון';
        if (isPairs) {
            noteEl.innerHTML = `ℹ️ <b>מצב זוגות חופשי (${timerTxt}):</b> משחק תורות — מי שמוצא זוג ממשיך לתור נוסף! פריסה של 4 קלפים בשורה (4 עד 12 זוגות) ותצוגה דו-כיוונית מותאמת.`;
        } else {
            noteEl.innerHTML = `ℹ️ <b>מצב יחיד חופשי (${timerTxt}):</b> ללא צבירת ניקוד כללי בפרופיל (אימון ותרגול רגוע).`;
        }
    }

    function openMemorySetupModal() {
        selectedFreeMemoryMode = MEMORY_MODES.FREE_SINGLE;
        selectedFreeMemoryPlayerIds = [];
        selectedFreeMemoryTimedMode = false;
        selectedFreeMemoryLevel = 2;
        document.getElementById('mem-player-search').value = '';
        selectFreeMemoryTimedMode(false);
        selectFreeMemoryDifficulty(2);
        selectFreeMemoryMode(MEMORY_MODES.FREE_SINGLE);
        document.getElementById('memory-setup-modal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeMemorySetupModal() {
        document.getElementById('memory-setup-modal').style.display = 'none';
    }

    function selectFreeMemoryMode(mode) {
        selectedFreeMemoryMode = mode;
        selectedFreeMemoryPlayerIds = [];
        const isPairs = (mode === MEMORY_MODES.FREE_PAIRS);

        document.getElementById('mem-mode-btn-single').classList.toggle('active-mode', !isPairs);
        document.getElementById('mem-mode-btn-pairs').classList.toggle('active-mode', isPairs);
        document.getElementById('mem-split180-wrapper').style.display = isPairs ? 'block' : 'none';

        const pickLabelEl = document.getElementById('mem-players-pick-label');
        if (isPairs) {
            pickLabelEl.innerText = 'בחר 2 מתמודדים לדו-קרב:';
        } else {
            pickLabelEl.innerText = 'בחר שחקן/ית לתרגול (1):';
        }
        updateFreeMemoryRuleNote();
        renderMemorySetupPlayersList();
    }

    function getAvailableMemoryProfiles() {
        let list = [];
        if (viewPreference === 'teams' || viewPreference === 'both') {
            registeredTeams.filter(t => t.kidsIds && t.kidsIds.length > 0).forEach(t => {
                list.push({
                    id: t.id,
                    name: t.name,
                    avatar: t.avatar || '👥',
                    isTeam: true,
                    classDesc: t.classDesc || '',
                    subtitle: `קבוצה${t.classDesc ? ' | ' + t.classDesc : ''}`
                });
            });
        }
        if (viewPreference === 'kids' || viewPreference === 'both') {
            registeredKids.forEach(k => {
                const cls = formatClassDisplay(k.classLetter, k.classNum);
                list.push({
                    id: k.id,
                    name: k.name,
                    avatar: k.avatar || '👦',
                    isTeam: false,
                    className: cls,
                    subtitle: `כיתה ${cls}`
                });
            });
        }
        return list;
    }

    function renderMemorySetupPlayersList() {
        const container = document.getElementById('mem-setup-players-list');
        if (!container) return;
        const maxAllowed = (selectedFreeMemoryMode === MEMORY_MODES.FREE_PAIRS) ? 2 : 1;
        const q = (document.getElementById('mem-player-search')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const profiles = getAvailableMemoryProfiles().filter(p => !q || p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || p.subtitle.toLowerCase().includes(q));

        if (profiles.length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML = `<p style="font-size:12px; color:#666; text-align:center; padding:10px;">לא נמצאו שחקנים או קבוצות.</p>`;
        } else {
            container.innerHTML = profiles.map(p => {
                const checked = selectedFreeMemoryPlayerIds.includes(p.id) ? 'checked' : '';
                return `<label class="player-select-item">
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
                        <span style="font-size:20px;">${p.avatar}</span>
                        <div><b>${p.name}</b> <span style="font-size:11px; color:#666;">(${p.subtitle})</span></div>
                    </div>
                    <input type="checkbox" value="${p.id}" ${checked} onchange="toggleFreeMemoryPlayer('${p.id}', this)" />
                </label>`;
            }).join('');
        }
        document.getElementById('mem-picked-count-label').innerText = `נבחרו: ${selectedFreeMemoryPlayerIds.length} / ${maxAllowed}`;
    }

    function toggleFreeMemoryPlayer(id, cb) {
        const maxAllowed = (selectedFreeMemoryMode === MEMORY_MODES.FREE_PAIRS) ? 2 : 1;
        if (cb.checked) {
            if (maxAllowed === 1) {
                selectedFreeMemoryPlayerIds = [id];
                renderMemorySetupPlayersList();
                return;
            }
            if (selectedFreeMemoryPlayerIds.length >= maxAllowed) {
                alert(`ניתן לבחור עד ${maxAllowed} מתמודדים!`);
                cb.checked = false;
                return;
            }
            selectedFreeMemoryPlayerIds.push(id);
        } else {
            selectedFreeMemoryPlayerIds = selectedFreeMemoryPlayerIds.filter(x => x !== id);
        }
        document.getElementById('mem-picked-count-label').innerText = `נבחרו: ${selectedFreeMemoryPlayerIds.length} / ${maxAllowed}`;
    }

    function launchFreeMemoryFromModal() {
        const requiredCount = (selectedFreeMemoryMode === MEMORY_MODES.FREE_PAIRS) ? 2 : 1;
        if (selectedFreeMemoryPlayerIds.length !== requiredCount) {
            alert(`נא לבחור בדיוק ${requiredCount} מתמודד/ים!`);
            return;
        }
        const level = selectedFreeMemoryLevel || 2;
        const isTimedMode = !!selectedFreeMemoryTimedMode;
        const is180Split = document.getElementById('mem-180split-checkbox').checked;
        const allProfiles = getAvailableMemoryProfiles();
        const chosenPlayers = selectedFreeMemoryPlayerIds.map(id => allProfiles.find(p => p.id === id)).filter(Boolean);

        closeMemorySetupModal();

        if (selectedFreeMemoryMode === MEMORY_MODES.FREE_SINGLE) {
            startFreeSingleMemory(chosenPlayers[0], level, isTimedMode);
        } else {
            startFreePairsMemory(chosenPlayers[0], chosenPlayers[1], level, is180Split, isTimedMode);
        }
    }

    function recordMemoryGameResult(summary, isCompleted = true) {
        if (!summary || typeof memoryTourneyManager === 'undefined') return;
        memoryTourneyManager.handleGameCompletion({
            ...summary,
            completed: isCompleted
        });
        if (typeof saveToLocalStorage === 'function') saveToLocalStorage();
        if (typeof renderCrossReport === 'function') renderCrossReport();
        if (typeof renderReportsScreen === 'function') renderReportsScreen();
        if (typeof refreshPdfReportData === 'function') refreshPdfReportData();
    }

    // הפעלת משחק זיכרון חופשי - שחקן יחיד (עם/ללא שעון, ללא ניקוד כללי)
    function startFreeSingleMemory(player, level = 2, hasTimer = false) {
        memoryEndReturnToTournament = false;
        activeMemoryController = new MemoryGameController({
            mode: MEMORY_MODES.FREE_SINGLE,
            level,
            hasTimer,
            players: [player],
            onRender: (state) => renderMemoryBoardUI(state),
            onComplete: (summary) => {
                recordMemoryGameResult(summary, true);
                const timeInfo = summary.elapsedSeconds !== null ? ` בזמן של ${summary.elapsedSeconds} שניות` : '';
                showEndModal("כל הכבוד! סיימת את התרגול בהצלחה 🎉", `תרגול יחיד הושלם${timeInfo} (${summary.players[0].attempts} ניסיונות). משחק חופשי אינו משפיע על הניקוד הכללי.`);
            }
        });
        activeMemoryController.start(window.APP_VOCABULARY_POOL);
    }

    // הפעלת משחק זיכרון חופשי - זוגות (עם/ללא שעון, לפי תורות)
    function startFreePairsMemory(player1, player2, level = 3, is180Split = true, hasTimer = false) {
        memoryEndReturnToTournament = false;
        activeMemoryController = new MemoryGameController({
            mode: MEMORY_MODES.FREE_PAIRS,
            level,
            is180Split,
            hasTimer,
            players: [player1, player2],
            onRender: (state) => renderMemoryBoardUI(state),
            onComplete: (summary) => {
                recordMemoryGameResult(summary, true);
                const p1 = summary.players[0];
                const p2 = summary.players[1];
                const timeInfo = summary.elapsedSeconds !== null ? `<br>⏱️ זמן משחק: <b>${summary.elapsedSeconds} שניות</b>` : '';
                showEndModal(
                    `המנצח/ת: ${summary.winner.name}! 🏆`,
                    `${p1.avatar} <b>${p1.name}</b>: ${p1.pairsFound} זוגות<br>${p2.avatar} <b>${p2.name}</b>: ${p2.pairsFound} זוגות${timeInfo}`
                );
            }
        });
        activeMemoryController.start(window.APP_VOCABULARY_POOL);
    }

    // דרישת סיסמת טורניר לפני כניסה לכל מקצה/דו-קרב בטורניר הזיכרון (בכל הפורמטים)
    // 1. בקשת סיסמת טורניר לכניסה / המשך משחק בטורניר הזיכרון
    function startMemoryTournamentMatch(tournamentId, matchId) {
        const tourney = memoryTourneyManager.tournaments.find(t => t.id === tournamentId);
        if (!tourney) return;
        const match = tourney.matches.find(m => m.matchId === matchId);
        if (!match) return;

        pendingMatchAction = {
            type: 'memory_enter',
            tournamentId: tournamentId,
            matchId: matchId
        };

        const isSingleTime = (tourney.subMode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_SINGLE_TIME);
        const isResume = (match.status === 'פעיל' && !!match.savedGameState);
        const matchDesc = isSingleTime
            ? `הזן את סיסמת הטורניר ל${isResume ? 'המשך' : 'התחלת'} מקצה נגד השעון של ${match.players[0]?.name || 'השחקן'}:`
            : `הזן את סיסמת הטורניר ל${isResume ? 'המשך' : 'הפעלת'} דו-קרב הזיכרון: ${match.players[0]?.name || ''} מול ${match.players[1]?.name || ''}`;

        document.getElementById('t-pwd-modal-title').innerText = isResume ? "⚡ המשך משחק בטורניר זיכרון" : "🔒 אבטחת טורניר זיכרון";
        document.getElementById('t-pwd-modal-desc').innerText = matchDesc;
        document.getElementById('t-pwd-input').value = "";
        document.getElementById('t-pwd-error').innerText = "";
        document.getElementById('tournament-pwd-modal').style.display = 'flex';
        setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('t-pwd-input').focus(), 80);
    }

    // 2. בקשת סיסמת טורניר לאיפוס משחק זיכרון (זהה ל-promptResetMatch בטורניר שאלות)
    function promptResetMemoryMatch(tournamentId, matchId) {
        pendingMatchAction = {
            type: 'memory_reset',
            tournamentId: tournamentId,
            matchId: matchId
        };
        document.getElementById('t-pwd-modal-title').innerText = "🔄 איפוס משחק בטורניר זיכרון";
        document.getElementById('t-pwd-modal-desc').innerText = "הזן את סיסמת הטורניר כדי לאפס משחק זה ולהתחיל מחדש:";
        document.getElementById('t-pwd-input').value = "";
        document.getElementById('t-pwd-error').innerText = "";
        document.getElementById('tournament-pwd-modal').style.display = 'flex';
        setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('t-pwd-input').focus(), 80);
    }

    function resetMemoryTournamentMatch(tournamentId, matchId) {
        memoryTourneyManager.resetMatch(tournamentId, matchId);
        updateUnifiedHomeTournamentCardUI();
        openPublicMemoryTournamentModal();
        alert("✅ משחק הזיכרון אופס בהצלחה! בכניסה הבאה הכל יתחיל מחדש.");
    }

    // 3. לאחר אימות סיסמה: אם זה דו-קרב זוגות -> מעבר למסך השהייה וספירה לאחור; אם יחיד -> כניסה ישירה
    function executeStartMemoryTournamentMatch(tournamentId, matchId) {
        const tourney = memoryTourneyManager.tournaments.find(t => t.id === tournamentId);
        if (!tourney) return;
        const match = tourney.matches.find(m => m.matchId === matchId);
        if (!match) return;

        document.getElementById('public-memory-tournament-modal').style.display = 'none';

        if (tourney.subMode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_PAIRS_WINNER) {
            prepareMemoryDuelStagingScreen(tourney, match);
        } else {
            launchMemoryTournamentMatchBoard(tournamentId, matchId);
        }
    }

    // מסך היערכות + כפתור ספירה לאחור (זהה לדו-קרב בטורניר שאלות)
    function prepareMemoryDuelStagingScreen(tourney, match) {
        pendingMemoryDuelLaunch = {
            tournamentId: tourney.id,
            matchId: match.matchId
        };

        const p1 = match.players[0];
        const p2 = match.players[1];
        const diffLabel = (MEMORY_DIFFICULTY[tourney.level] || MEMORY_DIFFICULTY[2]).label;
        const stageBadgeText = `🧠 ${match.roundName || 'דו-קרב זיכרון'} • ${diffLabel}`;

        document.getElementById('staging-p1-name').innerText = typeof formatParticipantLabelWithClass === 'function'
            ? formatParticipantLabelWithClass(p1)
            : `${p1.avatar || '🦁'} ${p1.name}`;
        document.getElementById('staging-p1-sub').innerText = p1.isTeam ? (p1.subtitle || '') : '';

        document.getElementById('staging-p2-name').innerText = typeof formatParticipantLabelWithClass === 'function'
            ? formatParticipantLabelWithClass(p2)
            : `${p2.avatar || '🦁'} ${p2.name}`;
        document.getElementById('staging-p2-sub').innerText = p2.isTeam ? (p2.subtitle || '') : '';

        document.getElementById('staging-game-label-top').innerText = stageBadgeText;
        document.getElementById('staging-game-label-bottom').innerText = stageBadgeText;

        document.getElementById('staging-countdown-box-top').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('staging-countdown-box-bottom').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('staging-start-msg-top').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('staging-start-msg-bottom').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('staging-start-controls-top').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('staging-start-controls-bottom').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('duel-staging-overlay').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    // פתיחת לוח הזיכרון בפועל (עם שחזור מצב אם קיים savedGameState)
    function launchMemoryTournamentMatchBoard(tournamentId, matchId) {
        const tourney = memoryTourneyManager.tournaments.find(t => t.id === tournamentId);
        if (!tourney) return;
        const match = tourney.matches.find(m => m.matchId === matchId);
        if (!match) return;

        memoryEndReturnToTournament = true;
        const savedSnapshot = (match.status === 'פעיל' && match.savedGameState) ? match.savedGameState : null;

        activeMemoryController = new MemoryGameController({
            mode: tourney.subMode,
            level: tourney.level,
            is180Split: tourney.is180Split,
            tournamentId: tourney.id,
            matchId: match.matchId,
            players: match.players,
            savedState: savedSnapshot,
            onRender: (state) => renderMemoryBoardUI(state),
            onComplete: (summary) => {
                recordMemoryGameResult(summary, true);
                updateUnifiedHomeTournamentCardUI();
                if (summary.mode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_SINGLE_TIME) {
                    showEndModal(
                        `סיימת ב-${summary.elapsedSeconds} שניות! ⏱️`,
                        `התוצאה של <b>${summary.players[0].name}</b> נשמרה בטבלת טורניר הזיכרון.`
                    );
                } else {
                    const p1 = summary.players[0];
                    const p2 = summary.players[1];
                    showEndModal(
                        `המנצח/ת בדו-קרב: ${summary.winner.name}! 🏆`,
                        `${p1.avatar} <b>${p1.name}</b>: ${p1.pairsFound} זוגות<br>${p2.avatar} <b>${p2.name}</b>: ${p2.pairsFound} זוגות`
                    );
                }
            }
        });
        activeMemoryController.start();
    }

    function renderMemoryBoardUI(state) {
        document.getElementById('game-hub-screen').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('writing-practice-screen').style.display = 'none';
        const spScrHide = document.getElementById('songs-practice-screen'); if (spScrHide) spScrHide.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('game-screen').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('split-screen-container').style.display = 'none';
        const topBadgeBar = document.getElementById('top-badge-bar');
        if (topBadgeBar) topBadgeBar.style.display = 'none';

        const memScreen = document.getElementById('memory-game-screen');
        memScreen.style.display = 'flex';

        const modeLabels = {
            free_single: '🧠 זיכרון חופשי • יחיד',
            free_pairs: '🧠 זיכרון חופשי • זוגות',
            tourney_single_time: '🏆 טורניר זיכרון • נגד השעון',
            tourney_pairs_winner: '🏆 טורניר זיכרון • דו-קרב'
        };
        const modeTitle = modeLabels[state.mode] || '🧠 משחק הזיכרון';
        const badgeP1 = document.getElementById('mem-mode-badge-p1');
        const badgeP2 = document.getElementById('mem-mode-badge-p2');
        if (badgeP1) badgeP1.innerText = modeTitle;
        if (badgeP2) badgeP2.innerText = modeTitle;

        const timerBadge = document.getElementById('mem-timer-badge');
        if (state.hasTimer) {
            timerBadge.style.display = 'inline-block';
            timerBadge.innerText = `⏱️ ${state.elapsedSeconds} שניות`;
        } else {
            timerBadge.style.display = 'none';
        }

        const isPairs = (state.players.length === 2);
        const p1Section = document.getElementById('mem-p1-section');
        const p2Section = document.getElementById('mem-p2-section');
        const p1Hud = document.getElementById('mem-p1-hud');
        const p2Hud = document.getElementById('mem-p2-hud');
        const statusBannerP1 = document.getElementById('mem-status-banner-p1');
        const statusBannerP2 = document.getElementById('mem-status-banner-p2');

        if (isPairs) {
            p1Section.style.display = 'flex';
            p2Section.style.display = 'flex';
            p1Hud.style.display = 'flex';
            p2Hud.style.display = 'flex';
            p1Section.style.transform = state.is180Split ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'none';

            const p1 = state.players[0];
            const p2 = state.players[1];
            document.getElementById('mem-p1-label').innerText = `${p1.avatar} ${p1.name}${state.currentPlayerIndex === 0 ? ' (תורך!)' : ''}`;
            document.getElementById('mem-p1-pairs').innerText = `🃏 זוגות: ${p1.pairsFound}`;
            document.getElementById('mem-p2-label').innerText = `${p2.avatar} ${p2.name}${state.currentPlayerIndex === 1 ? ' (תורך!)' : ''}`;
            document.getElementById('mem-p2-pairs').innerText = `🃏 זוגות: ${p2.pairsFound}`;

            p1Hud.classList.toggle('mem-active-turn-glow', state.currentPlayerIndex === 0);
            p2Hud.classList.toggle('mem-active-turn-glow', state.currentPlayerIndex === 1);

            const activeP = state.players[state.currentPlayerIndex];
            const turnStatusText = `תור: ${activeP.avatar} ${activeP.name} | ${state.matchedPairsTotal} מתוך ${state.totalPairs} זוגות`;
            statusBannerP1.innerText = turnStatusText;
            statusBannerP2.innerText = turnStatusText;
        } else {
            p1Section.style.display = 'flex';
            p1Section.style.transform = 'none';
            p1Hud.style.display = 'none';
            p2Section.style.display = 'none';
            const p1 = state.players[0];
            statusBannerP1.innerText = `${p1.avatar} ${p1.name} | ${state.matchedPairsTotal} מתוך ${state.totalPairs} זוגות`;
        }

        const boardEl = document.getElementById('memory-board-grid');
        boardEl.style.gridTemplateColumns = 'repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr))';

        const useDualView = (state.players.length === 2 && state.is180Split);

        boardEl.innerHTML = state.cards.map(card => {
            const cls = `memory-card ${card.isFlipped ? 'flipped' : ''} ${card.isMatched ? 'matched' : ''}`;
            if (card.isFlipped || card.isMatched) {
                if (useDualView) {
                    return `<div class="${cls}">
                        <div class="dual-view-card">
                            <div class="dual-view-half-top">${card.mainText}</div>
                            <div class="dual-view-half-bottom">${card.mainText}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
                }
                return `<div class="${cls}">
                    <div class="letter-face">${card.mainText}</div>
                    <div class="case-badge">${card.subText || ''}</div>
                </div>`;
            } else {
                if (useDualView) {
                    return `<div class="${cls}" onclick="onMemoryCardTap('${card.uid}')">
                        <div class="dual-view-card">
                            <div class="dual-view-half-top" style="font-size: 16px;">❓</div>
                            <div class="dual-view-half-bottom" style="font-size: 16px;">❓</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
                }
                return `<div class="${cls}" onclick="onMemoryCardTap('${card.uid}')">
                    <div style="font-size: 22px;">❓</div>
                </div>`;
            }
        }).join('');
    }

    function onMemoryCardTap(uid) {
        if (activeMemoryController) {
            activeMemoryController.handleCardClick(uid);
        }
    }

    // 4. שמירת מצב המשחק המדויק בעת יציאה באמצע משחק זיכרון בטורניר או משחק זוגות חופשי
    function exitMemoryGameScreen() {
        if (activeMemoryController) {
            activeMemoryController.stopTimer();
            if (activeMemoryController.isTournamentMode()) {
                activeMemoryController.persistActiveState();
            } else if (
                activeMemoryController.mode === MEMORY_MODES.FREE_PAIRS &&
                activeMemoryController.matchedPairsTotal > 0 &&
                activeMemoryController.matchedPairsTotal < activeMemoryController.pairsCount
            ) {
                const sortedP = [...activeMemoryController.players].sort((a, b) => b.pairsFound - a.pairsFound);
                const partialSummary = {
                    mode: activeMemoryController.mode,
                    isTournament: false,
                    tournamentId: null,
                    matchId: null,
                    level: activeMemoryController.level,
                    winner: sortedP[0] || activeMemoryController.players[0],
                    players: activeMemoryController.players,
                    elapsedSeconds: activeMemoryController.hasTimer ? activeMemoryController.elapsedSeconds : null,
                    countsForGlobalScore: false,
                    moveHistory: activeMemoryController.moveHistory,
                    completedAt: new Date().toISOString()
                };
                recordMemoryGameResult(partialSummary, false);
            }
            activeMemoryController = null;
        }
        document.getElementById('memory-game-screen').style.display = 'none';
        if (memoryEndReturnToTournament) {
            openPublicMemoryTournamentModal();
        } else {
            openHub();
        }
    }

    function showEndModal(title, detailsHtml) {
        try { if (typeof confetti === 'function') confetti({ particleCount: 90, spread: 75, origin: { y: 0.55 } }); } catch (e) {}
        document.getElementById('mem-end-title').innerText = title;
        document.getElementById('mem-end-details').innerHTML = detailsHtml;
        document.getElementById('memory-end-modal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeMemoryEndModal() {
        document.getElementById('memory-end-modal').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('memory-game-screen').style.display = 'none';
        activeMemoryController = null;
        if (memoryEndReturnToTournament) {
            openPublicMemoryTournamentModal();
        } else {
            openHub();
        }
    }

    /* =========================================================================
       לשונית ניהול טורניר הזיכרון הנפרד בהגדרות + מסך טורניר זיכרון ציבורי
       ========================================================================= */

    function getActiveMemoryTournament() {
    return memoryTourneyManager.tournaments.find(t => !isCancelledTournament(t) && (t.status === 'פעיל' || t.status === 'active')) || null;
}

    function updateHomeMemoryTournamentCardUI() {
        updateUnifiedHomeTournamentCardUI();
    }

    function handleHomeMemoryTournamentClick() {
        handleHomeUnifiedTournamentClick();
    }

    // 5. רינדור רשימת המקצים בטורניר הזיכרון עם כפתורי "המשך משחק פעיל" ו-"🔄 איפוס"
    function openPublicMemoryTournamentModal() {
        const tourney = getActiveMemoryTournament() || memoryTourneyManager.tournaments[memoryTourneyManager.tournaments.length - 1];
        if (!tourney) {
            openHub();
            return;
        }
        document.getElementById('pub-mem-t-header').innerText = `🧠 ${tourney.name}`;
        const bodyEl = document.getElementById('pub-mem-t-body');

        const isSingleTime = (tourney.subMode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_SINGLE_TIME);
        const subModeText = isSingleTime ? '⏱️ יחיד נגד השעון (דירוג לפי הזמן המהיר ביותר)' : '⚔️ דו-קרב זוגות ללא שעון (לפי מספר זוגות)';
        const diffLabel = (MEMORY_DIFFICULTY[tourney.level] || MEMORY_DIFFICULTY[2]).label;

        let html = `
            <div style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4c1d95, #7c3aed); color: white; padding: 11px 14px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
                <div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; color: #fde047;">🧠 ${tourney.name}</div>
                <div style="font-size: 11.5px; margin-top: 3px;">סוג טורניר: <b>${subModeText}</b></div>
                <div style="font-size: 11.5px; margin-top: 2px;">רמה: <b>${diffLabel}</b> | סטטוס: <b>${tourney.status}</b></div>
            </div>
        `;

        const standings = memoryTourneyManager.getTournamentStandings(tourney.id);
        if (standings.length > 0) {
            html += `<div style="background: #f5f3ff; border: 1.5px solid #c4b5fd; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
                <div style="font-weight: bold; color: #5b21b6; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 6px;">🏅 טבלת מובילים בטורניר הזיכרון:</div>`;
            standings.forEach((st, idx) => {
                const medal = idx === 0 ? '🥇' : (idx === 1 ? '🥈' : (idx === 2 ? '🥉' : `#${idx + 1}`));
                html += `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; background:white; padding:6px 10px; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:4px; font-size:12.5px; border:1px solid #ddd6fe;">
                    <span>${medal} ${st.player.avatar || '🦁'} <b>${st.player.name}</b></span>
                    <b style="color:#6d28d9;">${st.metricDisplay}</b>
                </div>`;
            });
            html += `</div>`;
        }

        if (tourney.champion) {
            html += `<div style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fef3c7, #fde68a); border: 2px solid #f59e0b; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; text-align: center;">
                <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #92400e;">👑 אלוף/ת הטורניר: ${tourney.champion.avatar || '🏆'} ${tourney.champion.name} 👑</div>
            </div>`;
        }

        if (isSingleTime) {
            html += `<div style="font-weight: bold; color: #03045e; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 6px;">📋 מקצי הטורניר (נגד השעון):</div>`;
            tourney.matches.forEach((m, idx) => {
                const isDone = (m.status === 'הסתיים');
                const isActive = (m.status === 'פעיל' && !!m.savedGameState);
                const p = m.players[0];
                const cardCls = isDone ? 'done-match' : (isActive ? 'active-match' : 'ready-match');
                const statusBadge = isDone
                    ? `⏱️ ${m.timeSeconds} שניות`
                    : (isActive ? `⚡ פעיל (${m.savedGameState.matchedPairsTotal}/${(MEMORY_DIFFICULTY[tourney.level] || MEMORY_DIFFICULTY[2]).pairs} זוגות)` : '🟢 זמין');

                let actionButtons = '';
                if (isDone) {
                    actionButtons = `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; margin-top:4px;">
                        <button type="button" onclick="promptResetMemoryMatch('${tourney.id}', '${m.matchId}')" style="background:#e63946; color:white; border:none; border-radius:8px; padding:5px 10px; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; cursor:pointer;">🔄 איפוס משחק</button>
                    </div>`;
                } else if (isActive) {
                    actionButtons = `<div style="display:flex; gap:6px; margin-top:4px;">
                        <button type="button" class="btn-action" onclick="startMemoryTournamentMatch('${tourney.id}', '${m.matchId}')" style="background:#f59e0b; color:#03045e; font-size:12px; padding:7px; flex:3;">⚡ המשך משחק פעיל</button>
                        <button type="button" onclick="promptResetMemoryMatch('${tourney.id}', '${m.matchId}')" style="background:#e63946; color:white; border:none; border-radius:10px; padding:6px 9px; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; cursor:pointer; flex:1;">🔄 איפוס</button>
                    </div>`;
                } else {
                    actionButtons = `<button type="button" class="btn-action" onclick="startMemoryTournamentMatch('${tourney.id}', '${m.matchId}')" style="background:#7c3aed; font-size:12px; padding:7px; width:100%; margin-top:4px;">⏱️ התחל מקצה נגד השעון</button>`;
                }

                html += `<div class="t-match-card ${cardCls}">
                    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
                        <span>מקצה #${idx + 1}: ${p.avatar || '🦁'} <b>${p.name}</b></span>
                        <span style="font-size:11.5px; font-weight:bold; color:${isDone ? '#15803d' : (isActive ? '#d97706' : '#6d28d9')};">${statusBadge}</span>
                    </div>
                    ${actionButtons}
                </div>`;
            });
        } else {
            const roundIndices = Array.from(new Set(tourney.matches.map(m => m.roundIdx || 0))).sort((a, b) => a - b);
            roundIndices.forEach(rIdx => {
                const roundMatches = tourney.matches.filter(m => (m.roundIdx || 0) === rIdx);
                const rTitle = roundMatches[0]?.roundName || `שלב ${rIdx + 1}`;
                html += `<div class="t-round-block">
                    <div class="t-round-title">
                        <span>${rTitle}</span>
                        <span style="font-size:11px; color:#5b21b6;">${roundMatches.filter(x => x.status === 'הסתיים').length}/${roundMatches.length} הושלמו</span>
                    </div>`;
                roundMatches.forEach(m => {
                    const isDone = (m.status === 'הסתיים');
                    const isActive = (m.status === 'פעיל' && !!m.savedGameState);
                    const p1 = m.players[0];
                    const p2 = m.players[1];
                    const isReady = (!isDone && !isActive && p1 && p2);
                    const cardCls = isDone ? 'done-match' : (isActive ? 'active-match' : (isReady ? 'ready-match' : 'locked-match'));
                    const p1Label = p1 ? `${p1.avatar || '🦁'} <b>${p1.name}</b> ${isDone ? `(${m.pairScores[p1.id]})` : ''}` : `<span style="color:#94a3b8;">⏳ ממתין לעולה...</span>`;
                    const p2Label = p2 ? `${p2.avatar || '🦁'} <b>${p2.name}</b> ${isDone ? `(${m.pairScores[p2.id]})` : ''}` : `<span style="color:#94a3b8;">⏳ ממתין לעולה...</span>`;
                    const winnerObj = isDone ? m.players.find(x => x && x.id === m.winnerId) : null;

                    let actionHtml = '';
                    if (isDone) {
                        actionHtml = `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-top:4px;">
                            <span style="font-size:11.5px; color:#15803d; font-weight:bold;">🏆 מנצח/ת ועולה שלב: ${winnerObj ? winnerObj.name : ''}</span>
                            <button type="button" onclick="promptResetMemoryMatch('${tourney.id}', '${m.matchId}')" style="background:#e63946; color:white; border:none; border-radius:6px; padding:4px 9px; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:bold; cursor:pointer;">🔄 איפוס משחק</button>
                        </div>`;
                    } else if (isActive) {
                        actionHtml = `<div style="display:flex; gap:6px; margin-top:4px;">
                            <button type="button" class="btn-action" onclick="startMemoryTournamentMatch('${tourney.id}', '${m.matchId}')" style="background:#f59e0b; color:#03045e; font-size:12px; padding:7px; flex:3;">⚔️ המשך משחק פעיל</button>
                            <button type="button" onclick="promptResetMemoryMatch('${tourney.id}', '${m.matchId}')" style="background:#e63946; color:white; border:none; border-radius:10px; padding:6px 9px; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; cursor:pointer; flex:1;">🔄 איפוס</button>
                        </div>`;
                    } else if (isReady) {
                        actionHtml = `<button type="button" class="btn-action" onclick="startMemoryTournamentMatch('${tourney.id}', '${m.matchId}')" style="background:#7c3aed; font-size:12px; padding:7px; width:100%; margin-top:4px;">⚔️ הפעל דו-קרב זיכרון</button>`;
                    } else {
                        actionHtml = `<div style="font-size:11px; color:#64748b; text-align:center;">🔒 המשחק ייפתח לאחר סיום השלב הקודם</div>`;
                    }

                    html += `<div class="t-match-card ${cardCls}">
                        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; font-size:12.5px;">
                            <span>${p1Label}</span>
                            <b style="color:#7c3aed;">VS</b>
                            <span>${p2Label}</span>
                        </div>
                        ${actionHtml}
                    </div>`;
                });
                html += `</div>`;
            });
        }

        bodyEl.innerHTML = html;
        document.getElementById('public-memory-tournament-modal').style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closePublicMemoryTournamentModal() {
        document.getElementById('public-memory-tournament-modal').style.display = 'none';
        openHub();
    }

    let adminMemTourneySelectedIds = [];
    let selectedAdminMemTourneySize = 4;

    function prepareAdminMemoryTournamentForm() {
        prepareAdminTournamentManagementForm();
    }

    function setAdminMemTourneySize(sz) {
        selectedAdminMemTourneySize = sz;
        [4, 8, 16].forEach(n => {
            const btn = document.getElementById(`admin-mem-sz-${n}`);
            if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active-tab', n === sz);
        });
        updateAdminMemSelectedCountLabel();
    }

    function updateAdminMemSelectedCountLabel() {
        const lbl = document.getElementById('admin-mem-selected-count');
        if (!lbl) return;
        const sub = document.getElementById('admin-mem-t-submode')?.value;
        if (sub === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_PAIRS_WINNER) {
            lbl.innerText = `נבחרו: ${adminMemTourneySelectedIds.length} מתוך ${selectedAdminMemTourneySize}`;
        } else {
            lbl.innerText = `נבחרו: ${adminMemTourneySelectedIds.length} (מינימום 2)`;
        }
    }

    function onAdminMemSubmodeChange() {
        const sub = document.getElementById('admin-mem-t-submode').value;
        const isPairs = (sub === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_PAIRS_WINNER);
        document.getElementById('admin-mem-t-180-box').style.display = isPairs ? 'block' : 'none';
        const sizeBox = document.getElementById('admin-mem-t-size-box');
        if (sizeBox) sizeBox.style.display = isPairs ? 'block' : 'none';
        updateAdminMemSelectedCountLabel();
    }

    function toggleAdminMemTourneyPlayer(id, cb) {
        const sub = document.getElementById('admin-mem-t-submode')?.value;
        if (cb.checked) {
            if (sub === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_PAIRS_WINNER && adminMemTourneySelectedIds.length >= selectedAdminMemTourneySize) {
                alert(`בטורניר דו-קרב של ${selectedAdminMemTourneySize} מתמודדים ניתן לבחור עד ${selectedAdminMemTourneySize} משתתפים!`);
                cb.checked = false;
                return;
            }
            if (!adminMemTourneySelectedIds.includes(id)) adminMemTourneySelectedIds.push(id);
        } else {
            adminMemTourneySelectedIds = adminMemTourneySelectedIds.filter(x => x !== id);
        }
        updateAdminMemSelectedCountLabel();
    }

    function createMemoryTournamentFromAdmin() {
        if (getUnifiedActiveTournament()) {
            alert("⚠️ קיים כרגע טורניר פעיל במערכת! לא ניתן להקים טורניר חדש עד לסיומו או ביטולו.");
            return;
        }
        const name = (document.getElementById('admin-mem-t-name').value || '').trim() || "טורניר הזיכרון";
        const password = (document.getElementById('admin-mem-t-pwd')?.value || '').trim() || "1234";
        const subMode = document.getElementById('admin-mem-t-submode').value;
        const level = parseInt(document.getElementById('admin-mem-t-level').value, 10) || 2;
        const is180Split = document.getElementById('admin-mem-t-180')?.checked || false;

        const allProfiles = getAvailableMemoryProfiles();
        const selectedPlayers = adminMemTourneySelectedIds.map(id => allProfiles.find(p => p.id === id)).filter(Boolean);

        if (subMode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_SINGLE_TIME && selectedPlayers.length < 2) {
            alert("בטורניר זיכרון נגד הזמן חובה לבחור לפחות 2 שחקנים!");
            return;
        }
        if (subMode === MEMORY_MODES.TOURNEY_PAIRS_WINNER && (![4, 8, 16].includes(selectedPlayers.length) || selectedPlayers.length !== selectedAdminMemTourneySize)) {
            alert(`בטורניר זיכרון דו-קרב יש לבחור בדיוק ${selectedAdminMemTourneySize} מתמודדים (4, 8 או 16 שחקנים בלבד)!`);
            return;
        }

        const created = memoryTourneyManager.createMemoryTournament({
            name,
            password,
            subMode,
            level,
            is180Split,
            selectedPlayers
        });

        updateUnifiedHomeTournamentCardUI();
        prepareAdminTournamentManagementForm();
        alert(`✅ טורניר הזיכרון "${created.name}" הוקם בהצלחה ונפתח במסך הבית!`);
    }

    function finishOrCloseActiveMemoryTournament(tId) {
    const t = memoryTourneyManager.tournaments.find(x => x.id === tId);
    if (!t) return;
    if (!confirm("האם לסגור ולבטל את טורניר הזיכרון הפעיל?")) return;
    t.status = 'cancelled';
    t.isCancelled = true;
    localStorage.removeItem('ewf_active_memory_match');
    memoryTourneyManager.save();
    updateUnifiedHomeTournamentCardUI();
    prepareAdminTournamentManagementForm();
}

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        updateUnifiedHomeTournamentCardUI();
    });
</script>
